Res Re-organization of the Jewish Gemeinde

For the purpose of re-organizing the Jewish
Gemeinde, the S.A.C.R.A. has formed a special committee, which
has been active throughout the month of August. In order to
obtain an indication, how such a re-organization should be
undertaken, the S.A.C.R.A. addressed the big refugee organiz-
ations regarding their ideas and opinions about the Jewish Ge-
meinde. Among the organizations approached, was the "ERU",
(European Stateless Refugees' Residents Union), which in turn
tried to gauge public opinion by having the street union leader
ask as many persons in their districts as possible and to report
For this purpose, the ERU printed questionnaires, containing 7
questions. 40% of the questionnaires were not returned at all,
and in general, the poll did not find much response.

After having collected the returned forms, the ERU
submitted a memorandum to the S.A.C.R.A., containing the result
of the questioning and ending in the suggestion, that due to
its inter-confessional and inter-national character, the ERU
would be best suited to represent the interests of the refugee
community.

Although it is generally admitted that the institu-
tions of the Jewish Gemeinde might be improved for the benefit
of the community, it seems unlikely that any reorganization what-
soever will, at the present moment at least, lead to a substan-
tial change of the refugees' situation, and would justify a lot
of conferences, enquiries and so forth. The little interest taken
in the ERU's poll is the best proof that the refugee community
attaches little importance to the organisatorical structural frame-
work of the Jewish Gemeinde, which is easy to understand in the
face of many others and more pressing problems of daily life
to which the community is subject.

The above matter also finds its echo in the press

为改组犹太公会，上海无国籍难民事务局（S.A.C.R.A.）成立了一个特别委员会，该委员会在整个八月份一直积极活动。为了了解应如何进行此类改组，上海无国籍难民事务局向各大难民组织征询了它们对犹太公会的看法和意见。在被征询的组织中，包括“欧洲无国籍难民居民联盟”（ERU, European Stateless Refugees' Residents Union），该联盟转而试图通过让街道联合会负责人尽可能多地询问其辖区内的居民并汇报情况来摸底公众舆论。为此，欧洲无国籍难民居民联盟印制了包含7个问题的问卷。40%的问卷根本未收回，总体而言，此次民意调查反响不大。

在收集回交的表格后，欧洲无国籍难民居民联盟向上海无国籍难民事务局提交了一份备忘录，其中包含了问卷调查的结果，并在结尾建议：鉴于其跨教派和跨国界的性质，欧洲无国籍难民居民联盟最适合代表难民群体的利益。

虽然人们普遍承认，犹太公会的机构可以为社区利益而加以改进，但似乎不太可能有任何重组——至少目前如此——会导致难民处境发生实质性变化，从而证明召开大量会议、进行调查等做法是正当的。人们对欧洲无国籍难民居民联盟的民意调查兴趣寥寥，这最好地证明了难民群体对犹太公会的组织架构框架重视程度不高，考虑到该群体面临着许多其他更紧迫的日常生活问题，这一点不难理解。

上述事项也在报刊上引起了反响

SUBJECT:
Reaction to the proclamation of 13.8.1944 re
Stateless Refugees and Stateless Nationals of
Jewish origin.(blackmarket circles).
The appearance of the proclamations issued
by Shanghai Ashkenazic Jewish Community in
name of Mr Kubota, the Commissioner of Jewish Aff
airs, created deep impression in the black-
market circles which in a large percent consist
of stateless refugees.
It was noticed yesterday, that though the
proclamations in no way affected Jews of various
nationalities other than stateless, it created
among such Jews feeling of nervousness.
The news was widely commented and fear was
expressed that the registration might be
followed by some other measures, such as creation
of another designated area etc.
It was noticed also that a number of such
persons especially those really affected are
thinking of selling of their flats and apartments
before any restrictions have been imposed for
such transactions.
Attempts are made by persons concerned
to find out the reason of such measure and among
the explanations one is given to the effect that
in near future in occupied Poland might be
established a government which will endeavour
to take stateless refugees under protection.
As such government shall not be recognised by
Japan, but those nationals or refugees, who
will secure the passports of this government
will place themselves in position of nationals
of nations unfriendly to Japan the local
authorities are compelled to enforce some sort
of control over their activities.
P. Konopacki.
D.I.
Officer i/c Foreign
Affairs Branch.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（批：No, 8/15/44）

Station. Foreign Affairs Section File No. Date. 15.8.1944.

SUBJECT: opinion of foreign circles re registration of baltic nationals.

The notifications published in yesterday's papers regarding registration of stateless refugees is in general misunderstood by different foreign circles. It is remembered that when first proclamation regarding registration of German refugees of Jewish origin was made, no specification concerning Jewish origin of the persons to be registered, was mentioned. So, as that Proclamation concerned Jews it is supposed by many persons that this registration concerns only persons of Jewish origin. This is especially because the nationals of Baltic countries who arrived in Shanghai before the outbreak of the war, do not consider themselves as "refugees", so the most part of them are sure that this proclamation does not regard them.

As to the opinion regarding another registration, it is supposed that the main purpose of the same is to have full information regarding those nationals whose countries will probably be occupied in a short time by Soviet troops. As in case of such occupation of these countries there will be officially two governments - one in the country occupied (this government will be formed by Soviets) and another government in London (or elsewhere). In the case the attitude of Japan towards the new situation in Baltic countries is unclear, it is natural that all nationals of these countries should be closely registered. It is supposed that if Japan will recognize the established pro-Soviet government in Baltic countries (which fact is not seen to be very probable), then local Japanese authorities will oblige all Baltic nationals to make their choice and to express their convictions regarding two governments.

It is also supposed that such registration is announced in execution of a project according to which all foreigners in Shanghai will be obliged to reside in different officially designated areas.

It is also supposed that Japanese authorities will request in future some kind of contribution from all circles of foreigners in Shanghai in order to help improvement of war funds. It is said that such contribution were recently paid by some Chinese circles. Anyhow nobody believes that this registration is made in purpose of statistics.

（印：後橋）

警署：外事科 档案号： 日期：1944年8月15日。

主题：外籍人士圈子对波罗的海国家国民登记的意见。

昨日报纸上刊登的关于无国籍难民登记的通知，普遍被不同外籍人士圈子所误解。人们记得，当首次发布关于犹太裔德国难民登记的公告时，并未提及待登记人员的犹太裔身份具体规定。因此，既然该公告涉及犹太人，许多人便认为此次登记仅涉及犹太裔人员。这尤其是因为战前抵达上海的波罗的海国家国民并不认为自己是“难民”，所以他们中的大多数人确信该公告与他们无关。

至于对另一次登记的看法，人们推测其主要目的是全面掌握那些所属国家可能在短期内被苏联军队占领的国民的信息。因为一旦这些国家被占领，将在官方上存在两个政府——一个是被占领国的政府（由苏维埃组建），另一个是位于伦敦（或其他地方）的政府。鉴于日本对波罗的海国家新局面态度不明，自然应对这些国家的所有国民进行严密登记。人们推测，如果日本承认在波罗的海国家建立的亲苏政府（这一事实看来可能性不大），那么日本地方当局将迫使所有波罗的海国家国民做出选择，并就两个政府表明其立场。

还有人推测，此次登记的宣布是为了执行一项计划，根据该计划，所有在上海的外国人将被迫居住在不同的官方指定区域内。

此外还有人推测，日本当局将来会要求在上海的所有外籍人士圈子提供某种捐款，以帮助改善战争资金。据说最近一些华人圈子已缴纳了此类捐款。无论如何，没有人相信这次登记是为了统计目的。

（印：後橋）

Foreign Affairs.
15-8-1944

Reaction on Proclamation issued by the Stateless Refugees from Europe Bureau and Notification published by the Association Ashkenazi of Shanghai.

The announcement of the above Proclamation and Notification caused a large reaction among the person concerned and also was discussed with interest by foreign community in general. The prevailing opinion is that issue of Proclamation is motivated by the desire of Japan Japanese Authorities to ascertain exact civil status and number of all stateless refugees in Shanghai, the native countries of which are being at present occupied by the Soviet troops and in which Soviet republics or regimes friendly to USSR are going to be established, such as in Poland, Checco-Slovakia etc. In this case it is thought possible that Japan, in view of her friendly relations with USSR, may recognize these regimes and as a consequence of this all refugees concerned would discontinue to be such and their position would considerably improve.

There are also rumours that this registration is done with a view to place the remainder of stateless refugees in the Designated Area. The reasons for such measure is said to be spreading of various rumours which were circulated in town recently and in which refugees are accused. Supporters of this opinion point out Notification to all refugees of Jewish origin to register.

In connection with these rumours much unrest
was felt in Shanghai among all Jews, including those registered with the Russian Emigrants Committee and many of them are preparing to sell their property, appartments etc.

B. Vardoff

1944年8月15日

关于欧洲无国籍难民局发布的公告及上海阿什肯纳兹协会（Association Ashkenazi of Shanghai）发布的通知所引起的反响。

上述公告和通知的发布在相关人士中引起了巨大反响，也引起了外侨社区的广泛关注和讨论。 prevailing opinion（普遍观点）认为，发布该公告的动机在于日本当局希望查明所有在上海的无国籍难民的确切民事身份和人数，这些难民的原籍国目前正被苏联军队占领，且将在这些国家建立苏维埃共和国或亲苏政权，例如波兰、捷克斯洛伐克等。在这种情况下，人们认为，鉴于日本与苏联的友好关系，日本可能会承认这些政权，因此，所有相关难民将不再具有无国籍身份，其处境将得到显著改善。

另有谣言称，进行此次登记是为了将剩余的无国籍难民安置于“指定区域”。据说采取这一措施的原因是最近在上海流传的各种谣言，而这些谣言中难民受到指责。持此观点的人指出，通知要求所有犹太裔难民进行登记。

由于这些谣言，上海的所有犹太人，包括已在俄罗斯移民委员会登记的人，都感到极度不安，其中许多人正准备出售他们的财产、公寓等。

B. Vardoff

Important Re-Organization of S.A.C.R.A.

The Russian Jewish as well as the refugee-Jewish
press are publishing a bulletin of the first general meeting
which was held on April 27th, 1944 by the newly appointed
committee members of S.A.C.R.A.

The contents of the bulletin will be of extreme im-
portance to the entire Jewish population of Shanghai since
through the recent re-organization of S.A.C.R.A., all Jewish
organizations in Shanghai will be under the control of S.A.C.
R.A., and all Shanghai Jews, stateless or non-stateless, will
have to do their share towards the formation of funds for
relief to stateless refugees..

The first part of the bulletin contains 8 points, as
follows:-
1. All Stateless Jewish residents in Shanghai,
who are not subject to the Proclamation of the 18th
February 1943, issued by the Supreme Commands of the
Imperial Japanese Army and Navy of the Shanghai area
are considered as regular members of the S.A.C.R.A.
and are to be requested to register as such.
2. All non-stateless Jewish residents in Shanghai are
to be considered as supporting members of S.A.C.R.A.
and are to be requested to give their voluntary
assistance to promote the good samaritarian work
of S.A.C.R.A. for the benefit of the refugees.
3. S.A.C.R.A. is to control, supervise, support, and
administer, as the need may be, all the Jewish or-
ganizations in the Shanghai Area.
4. The "Joint Administrative Committee" (J.A.C.) is to be
reorganized by the appointment of the required mem-
bers from the various associations in the designat-
ed area (such as the Jewish Gemeinde, Polish Emigrant
Association, Czech Circle, Catholic Federation, Pro-
testant Association), and to attend to the various
and numerous needs of the refugees in the Area under
supervision of S.A.C.R.A.
5. All members of S.A.C.R.A. are to contribute as a Tax
the amount assessed by the Finance Committee in con-
junction with a specially elected Taxation Committee
6. On Sunday, May 7th, a General Meeting of all Jewish
residents is to be held in order to elect the Assess-
ment Board Committee members.
7. The collection of all outstanding amounts is to be
immediately proceeded with.
8. Supporting members of the S.A.C.R.A. are to be re-
quested to forward their donations.

犹太档案

1944年5月12日
外交事务科
特别部
上海援助委员会俄罗斯分部（S.A.C.R.A.）的重要重组

俄罗斯犹太媒体以及难民犹太媒体均刊登了由上海援助委员会俄罗斯分部（S.A.C.R.A.）新任命委员于1944年4月27日举行的第一次全体会议的公报。

该公报的内容对上海全体犹太居民极为重要，因为通过近期对上海援助委员会俄罗斯分部（S.A.C.R.A.）的重组，上海的所有犹太组织都将受其控制，所有上海犹太人，无论是否拥有国籍，都必须为建立救助无国籍难民的基金贡献力量。

公报的第一部分包含以下8点：
1. 所有在上海的无国籍犹太居民，凡不受1943年2月18日由上海地区日本帝国陆海军最高指挥部发布的公告约束者，均被视为上海援助委员会俄罗斯分部（S.A.C.R.A.）的正式成员，并被要求以此身份进行登记。
2. 所有在上海的非无国籍犹太居民均被视为上海援助委员会俄罗斯分部（S.A.C.R.A.）的支持会员，并被请求自愿提供协助，以促进该会为难民利益开展的慈善工作。
3. 上海援助委员会俄罗斯分部（S.A.C.R.A.）将根据需要，控制、监督、支持和管理上海地区的所有犹太组织。
4. “联合行政委员会”（J.A.C.）将通过从指定区域内的各协会（如犹太公会、波兰移民协会、捷克圈、天主教联合会、新教协会）任命所需成员来进行重组，并在上海援助委员会俄罗斯分部（S.A.C.R.A.）的监督下，处理区域内难民的各种众多需求。
5. 上海援助委员会俄罗斯分部（S.A.C.R.A.）的所有成员均需缴纳由财务委员会与特别选举产生的税务委员会共同评定的税款。
6. 5月7日（星期日）将举行所有犹太居民的全体会议，以选举评估委员会成员。
7. 立即着手催收所有欠款。
8. 请求上海援助委员会俄罗斯分部（S.A.C.R.A.）的支持会员提交捐款。

The bulletin furthermore mentions the Housing
and the Health problems which will be attended to. As regards
the suspension of the activities of the Jewish Recreation Club
Messrs. Tocchinsky and Ysnovich have been appointed to take
over the reorganization of the J.R.C. with view to re-open the
Choufong Road sportsgrounds as soon as possible.
The main part of the bulletin is occupied by a
speech by Mr. T. Kubota, extracts of which are following:-
Mr. Kubota explained that the reorganization of S.
A.C.R.A. was necessary, because in spite of the fact that the
Association had done hard and difficult work, better results
might have been achieved,, had the Association not been hamper-
ed by some of the supporters and refugees by unnecessary
complaints and petty arguments, and also by a certain lack
of authority. Thereby, the S.A.C.R.A. lost much of its initial
vigor, which the reorganization is expected to
bring back. Mr. Kubota then gave the example of the Japanese
Residents' Association, which acts as an intermediary between
the Japanese Consulate and the Japanese population of Shanghai
who are under the former's jurisdiction. Similarly, the new
S.A.C.R.A., having by this reorganization been raised to the
standard corresponding to that of the S'hai Japanese Residents
Association, and presided by the representative of the Imperi-
al Japanese Government with the full authority and backing,
will supervise, control, support, and administer all the Jew-
ish organizations in the SHanghai area and lead them properly
in collaboration with the policy of the Authorities.
The present standard of the S.A.C.R.A., in colla-
boration with the Shanghai Stateless Refugee Affairs Bureau,
will produce smooth co-operation towards refugee relief, and
steps will be taken against those who might impede the pro-
gress of S.A.C.R.A.'s undertakings.
Regarding the S.S.R.A.B.'s execution of the pro-

公报还提及了将予以处理的住房和健康问题。关于犹太娱乐俱乐部活动的暂停，Tocchinsky 先生和 Ysnovich 先生已被任命负责该俱乐部的重组工作，以便尽快重新开放兆丰路（Choufong Road）运动场。
公报的主要内容是久保田（T. Kubota）先生的讲话，摘录如下：
久保田先生解释说，重组上海援助委员会俄罗斯分部（S.A.C.R.A.）是必要的，因为尽管该协会做了艰苦困难的工作，但如果没有受到一些支持者和难民不必要的抱怨和琐碎争论的阻碍，以及缺乏一定的权威，本可以取得更好的成果。因此，上海援助委员会俄罗斯分部（S.A.C.R.A.）失去了初期的许多活力，而重组预计将恢复这种活力。随后，久保田先生以日本居留民团为例，该团作为日本领事馆与其管辖下的上海日本居民之间的中介。同样，新的上海援助委员会俄罗斯分部（S.A.C.R.A.）通过此次重组，其地位已提升至与上海日本居留民团相当的标准，并由拥有充分权力和支持的日本政府代表主持，将监督、控制、支持和管理上海地区的所有犹太组织，并与当局的政策合作，对其进行正确引导。
上海援助委员会俄罗斯分部（S.A.C.R.A.）目前的水平，在与上海无国籍难民事务局的合作下，将为难民救济工作产生顺畅的合作，并将对那些可能阻碍上海援助委员会俄罗斯分部（S.A.C.R.A.）工作进展的人采取措施。

clamation, Mr.Kubota stated that up to March 20th, 1944
a very lenient attitude had been displayed by the Bureau
towards violators, but that the time has now come for ri-
gorous steps. Compassion for those who still fail to com-
ply with the regulations would be out of place. This refers
particularly to Polish refugees, who represent nearly
100 %/o of the violators. Having been fortunate enough,
not to be considered enemy nationals, thus being spared
the confiscation of their property etc., they have conti-
nuously acted most regrettably and badly annoyed the autho-

Mr.Kubota asked for whole-hearted co-
operation of all concerned organizations with the S.A.C.R.A.
and to avoid petty personal squabbles. Regarding the dispens-
ing of charity, he said that the helpless and those unable
to work must of course be supported, but it would be wrong
to dispense charity without proper consideration.

Concluding, Mr. Kubota pointed out, that he
fully realized the difficulties of the work to be done,
but any effort will be appreciated. He requested all
committee members to draft detailed plans for the benefit
of their own people.

The meeting closed with a vote of thanks to
Mr.Kubota for his assistance and guidance, which was unani-
mously accepted.

久保田先生请求所有相关组织与上海援助委员会俄罗斯分部（S.A.C.R.A.）全心合作，避免琐碎的个人争执。关于慈善发放，他表示，当然必须支持无助者和无法工作者，但不加适当考虑地发放慈善物资是错误的。

最后，久保田先生指出，他充分认识到即将开展的工作的困难，但任何努力都将受到赞赏。他请求所有委员为其本族人民的利益起草详细计划。

会议在对久保田先生的协助和指导表示感谢的投票中结束，该提议获一致通过。

Shanghai, May 5, 1944

First General Meeting
of the Newly Appointed Committee Members
of the Ashkenazi Collaborating Relief Association
IMPORTANT SPEECH BY MR. T. KUBOTA

On Thursday, 27th April took place the General Meeting of all the newly appointed Committee Members of SACRA presided by Mr. T. Kubota, the Director General of the Shanghai Bureau for Stateless Refugee Affairs, who is now concurrently the Hon. President of the SACRA Committee, and Mr. M. Kano as Secretary General of SACRA.

The Meeting was opened by the speech of Dr. A.J. Cohn, Hon. Chairman of the Administrative and Executive Committee, in which he introduced the newly appointed members; and then had the minutes of previous meetings read by the secretary. After some discussions and corrections the minutes were accepted by the Committee and sanctioned by the Hon. President.

The contents of the minutes accepted and sanctioned are as follows:
1. All stateless Jewish residents in Shanghai, who are not subject to the Proclamation of the 18th February 1943, issued by the Supercommands of the Imperial Japanese Army and Navy of the Shanghai Area, are considered as regular members of the SACRA and are to be requested to register as such.
2. All non-stateless Jewish residents in Shanghai are to be considered as supporting members of SACRA and are to be requested to give their voluntary assistance to promote the good humanitarian work of SACRA for the benefit of the refugees.
3. SACRA is to control, supervise, support and administer as the need may be, ALL the Jewish organizations in the Shanghai Area.
4. To reorganize the J.A.C. (Joint Administrative Committee) by appointing the required members from the various associations in the Designated Area (such as Juedische Gemeinde, Polish Emigrant Association, Czech Circle, Catholic Federation, Protestant Association) and to attend to the various and numerous needs of the refugees in the Area under supervision of SACRA

Financial Questions
5. All members of SACRA to contribute as a Tax the amount assessed by the Finance Committee in conjunction with a specially elected Taxation Committee.
6. On Sunday, May 7th to hold a General Meeting of all Jewish residents in order to elect the Assessment Board Committee members.
7. To proceed immediately with collecting of all the outstanding amounts.
8. To request all the supporting members of SACRA to forward their donations.

Housing Question
Owing to lack of space the Housing Committee will give specified reports in future.

Health Question
In view of the approach of warm weather, by suggestion of Dr. Cohn it has been decided to request the Medical Board of the Shanghai Jewish Hospital to make the necessary appointments and to supervise together with the Physicians' Association in the Area and the Kitchen Fund Hospital Medical Board the start of active sanitary precautions.

J.R.C.
In connection with the closing of the playgrounds of the Jewish Recreation Club and the order of dissolution of the Board of Stewards owing to mismanagement, it was suggested to appoint Mr. Toochnisky and Mr. Yanovicz to take over the task of the reorganization of the J.R.C., to present to the SACRA Committee plans for reopening the grounds as soon as possible.

Mr. Kubota's speech
The Honourary President, Mr. T. Kubota, spoke on the occasion as follows:

The Authorities are fully cognizant of the hard and difficult work undertaken and rather successfully accomplished by the SACR during the past year. But I have also to remark that its work was very

Lectures Sponsored by the Trust Fund of Sympathy

Furthering its aim to offer constructive help to refugee intellectuals, the Trust Fund of Sympathy sponsored during April the following lectures read within the framework of different cultural institutes in the Designated Area.
"Indian Architecture" by L. Ponzen (Asia Seminar) on April 9th.
"Japanese Coloured Woodcuts" by M. Rosenfeld (Asia Seminar) on April 16.
"Beethoven's Personality, Characteristics and Peculiarities" by H. Markt (Supplementary Education Courses of the Juedische Gemeinde) on April 20th.
"Technique of Book and Newspaper Printing" by A. Kornik (Supplementary Education Courses of the Juedische Gemeinde) on April 27th.
The following lectures sponsored the Trust Fund of Sympathy are scheduled to take place in the near future, the date and the place to be announced in the Shanghai Jewish Chronicle:
"Orchestra Composition" by M. Hausdorf, "Various Systems of Banking" by Hoexter, "Light and Colour" by Loewin, "Ibsen and Hauptmann" by Dr. Neuman, "Calculating Machines" by Reiter.
All the lectures sponsored by the Trust Fund of Sympathy are open to public. Entrance free.

Tea-party for Camp Children Arranged
by Cafe "Barcelona"

The proprietors of the "Barcelona" cafe in the Designated Area arranged a special tea-party for the poorest children, inhabitants of the camps, on Saturday afternoon, April 29th. This tea-party was attended by 125 children who were offered sweets and entertainments. Mr. Ghoya of the Stateless Refugee Bureau and Mr. Hoyama of the Wayside Police Station attended this function, Mr. Ghoya delivering a speech in which he expressed his satisfaction to see the poorest children and among them 7 orphans being entertained by the "Barcelona" proprietors. Mr. Ghoya told the children two stories which were greatly appreciated by the young audience. The tea-party was attended by representatives of the Kitchen Fund, the Juedische Gemeinde, composer Leopold Maas and many others.

This brought about an apparent loss of SACRA's initial vigour in pursuing the main object of its constructive relief work, which was, in my opinion, due to SACRA's lack of full authority, and it is expected that this reorganization will enable SACRA to achieve its proper aims.
Secondly, I have always been of the opinion to allow the local Jewish colony as much as possible to organize and govern their affairs by themselves under a supervision of an organization which would be in the position to depute to the Authorities in charge.
For example, the Japanese residents here are subject directly to the Japanese Consular jurisdiction and supervision, but the Japanese Residents' Association here deputise such supervision and collect the tax, conduct the Hospital, relief and other needed works, thus replacing partly the work which otherwise would have to be done by the Japanese Authorities directly.
Similarly, the new SACRA, having by this reorganization been raised to the standard corresponding to that of the Shanghai Japanese Residents' Association and presided by the representative of the Imperial Japanese Government, with the full authority and backing, will supervise, control, support and administer all the Jewish organisations in the Shanghai Area and lead them properly in collaboration with the policy of the Authorities.

上海，1944年5月5日

阿什肯纳兹合作救济协会
新任命委员第一次全体会议
久保田先生发表重要演讲

4月27日星期四，举行了阿什肯纳兹合作救济协会（SACRA）所有新任命委员的全体会议。会议由上海无国籍难民事务局局长久保田（T. Kubota）先生主持，他目前兼任SACRA委员会名誉主席，加诺（M. Kano）先生担任SACRA秘书长。

会议首先由行政与执行委员会名誉主席科恩（A.J. Cohn）博士致开幕词，他在讲话中介绍了新任命的委员；随后由秘书宣读前几次会议的纪要。经过一些讨论和修正，纪要获委员会通过，并经名誉主席批准。

获批准和认可的纪要内容如下：
1. 上海所有不受1943年2月18日上海地区日本帝国陆海军最高指挥官公告约束的无国籍犹太居民，均被视为SACRA的正式会员，并被要求以此身份进行登记。
2. 上海所有非无国籍犹太居民均被视为SACRA的支持会员，并被请求提供自愿援助，以促进SACRA为难民利益开展的有益人道主义工作。
3. SACRA将根据需要，对上海地区的所有犹太组织进行控制、监督、支持和管理。
4. 通过从指定区域内的各协会（如犹太公会、波兰移民协会、捷克圈、天主教联合会、新教协会）中任命所需成员，重组联合行政委员会（J.A.C.），并在SACRA的监督下，处理该地区难民的各种且众多的需求。

财务问题
5. SACRA的所有成员须缴纳由财务委员会与特别选举产生的征税委员会共同评定的税款。
6. 于5月7日星期日举行全体犹太居民大会，以选举评估委员会成员。
7. 立即着手收取所有欠款。
8. 请求SACRA的所有支持会员提交捐款。

住房问题
由于空间不足，住房委员会将在未来提供具体报告。

卫生问题
鉴于天气渐暖，根据科恩博士的建议，决定请求上海犹太医院医务委员会作出必要安排，并与该地区的医师协会及厨房基金医院医务委员会共同监督，启动积极的卫生预防措施。

犹太娱乐俱乐部（J.R.C.）
鉴于犹太娱乐俱乐部游乐场关闭，且其管理委员会因管理不善而被下令解散，有人建议任命图奇尼斯基（Toochnisky）先生和亚诺维奇（Yanovicz）先生接管J.R.C.的重组工作，并向SACRA委员会提交尽快重新开放场地的计划。

久保田先生的演讲
名誉主席久保田（T. Kubota）先生就此场合发表如下讲话：
“SACRA委员会的这一新架构是出于以下原因：
当局充分认识到SACRA在过去一年中承担并相当成功完成的艰苦困难工作。但我也不得不指出，其工作受到了极大阻碍……

由同情信托基金赞助的讲座

为进一步实现向难民知识分子提供建设性帮助的目标，同情信托基金于4月期间，在指定区域内不同文化机构的框架下赞助了以下讲座：
4月9日，L. Ponzen主讲“印度建筑”（亚洲研讨会）。
4月16日，M. Rosenfeld主讲“日本彩色木刻”（亚洲研讨会）。
4月20日，H. Markt主讲“贝多芬的个性、特征及特点”（犹太公会补充教育课程）。
4月27日，A. Kornik主讲“书籍与报纸印刷技术”（犹太公会补充教育课程）。
由同情信托基金赞助的以下讲座计划在近期举行，日期和地点将在《上海犹太纪事报》上公布：
M. Hausdorf主讲“管弦乐作曲”，Hoexter主讲“各种银行体系”，Loewin主讲“光与色”，Neuman博士主讲“易卜生与豪普特曼”，Reiter主讲“计算机器”。
所有由同情信托基金赞助的讲座均向公众开放。免费入场。

由“巴塞罗那”咖啡馆安排的难民营儿童茶话会

指定区域内“巴塞罗那”咖啡馆的业主于4月29日星期六下午，为最贫困的难民营儿童居民安排了一场特别的茶话会。共有125名儿童参加了此次茶话会，享用了糖果和娱乐节目。无国籍难民局的戈亚（Ghoya）先生和路边警察局的霍亚马（Hoyama）先生出席了此次活动，戈亚先生在致辞中表示，看到最贫困的儿童，其中包括7名孤儿，得到“巴塞罗那”业主的款待，他感到满意。戈亚先生给孩子们讲了两个故事，深受小听众们的喜爱。出席茶话会的还有厨房基金代表、犹太公会代表、作曲家利奥波德·马斯（Leopold Maas）以及许多其他人。

……受到难民和SACRA支持者中各种分子的严重阻碍，这些人由于缺乏理解或合作意愿，用各种投诉和琐事给SACRA委员会增加了负担，使得委员会没有时间和体力去开展更急需的建设性救济工作，而某些支持者的不付款则在财政上阻碍了SACRA的及时工作。这导致SACRA在追求其建设性救济工作的主要目标时，明显丧失了最初的活力，我认为这是由于SACRA缺乏完全授权所致，预计这次重组将使SACRA能够实现其适当的目标。
其次，我一直主张让当地犹太社群在某个能够向主管当局代表的组织的监督下，尽可能自行组织和管理其事务。
例如，这里的日本居民直接受日本领事管辖和监督，但这里的日本居留民团代为行使这种监督并征收税款，经营医院、救济和其他必要的工作，从而部分取代了否则必须由日本当局直接完成的工作。
同样，新的SACRA通过此次重组，已提升至与上海日本居留民团相应的标准，并由日本政府代表主持，拥有完全的权力和支持，将监督、控制、支持和管理上海地区的所有犹太组织，并在与当局政策协作的情况下正确引导它们。

OUR LIFE
Friday, May 5 1944.

PROFESSIONAL STRUCTURE OF THE JEWS
By Dr. E. Kayfman

We often hear complaints to the effect that little or nothing is known about economic and professional structure of the Jews in ancient and middle age. According to some scholars, we possess no statistics and therefore lack trustworthy information. But, although it is true that there is no statistics available for these periods, other peoples are in no better position than ourselves in this respect, and yet we know of their economic structure in the past. In the same measure we may judge of the economic structure of the Jews in the time gone by. Works of Karo, Uster and others have long proved the fact that in the first millenium of our era the Jews were not only engaged in various professions but that the great majority of them lived from cultivating the soil and plying different crafts. There is enough material available for the above conclusion even despite the lack of proper statistics.

The famous historian Joseph emphasized that fact that the Jews differed from the Egyptians and the Hanaans whose main occupation was trade, he also mentioned that it was not

the Jewish practice to hire slaves; both hints are sufficient to make conclusions as to the economic status of the Jews in that time, even although he gives us no statistical data. And, likewise, when we read in the Talmud (Sukko page 51, 72) the description of the luxurious synagogue in Alexandria and come across the reference to craftsmen only, we may draw therefrom the conclusion that handicraft was the main source of earning for the Jews in the Egyptian diaspora. Other Talmudic sources help to leave us entirely without doubt in the mind that the Jews during the Talmudic period were engaged principally in land cultivating and handicrafts. Goldschmidt makes the same conclusion and asserts that the Jews were not a trading nation at that time. The same applies to the next few centuries. Babylonian Jews were also mostly engaged in agriculture and handicrafts. Only in the beginning of the 8th century they began penetrating into the sphere of commerce. The Jews of Arabia at the Mohammed era were mostly peasants and craftsmen, with trade playing a very insignificant part in their economical structure. Byzanthine Jews up

to the tenth century were engaged mainly in agriculture and but a few in industry and handicraft. From the descriptions of the well-known Jewish travellers Rabbi Benjamin of Tudela and Rabbi Petahia of Ratisbon and also from other sources we have learned that up to the middle of the fourteenth century the Jews living in the Orient under the rule of crusaders and caliphs were mostly farmers and craftsmen. According to Benjamin, the same applies to the Jews living in Greece and her islands. In the Sicily of the 16th century the majority of the Jews were craftsmen. In this connection it is interesting to note that in 1492, when the Jews were expelled from Spain and this order was made applicable also to Sicily, the Christians of this country petitioned the Government to permit the Jews to stay on in order to save the Sicilian industry from ruin, as most of the locksmiths, ship carpenters and masons in Sicily were Jews. St. Thomas Aquina also confirms the fact that most of the Italian Jews were workmen. There exist officials records in Rome dating the beginning of the 17th century wherein it is mentioned that out of 91 heads of the Jewish families 50 were craftsmen.

In Spain about twelve different crafts were considered predominantly Jewish. In the Jewish quarter of Saragossa there existed whole streets of furriers, shoemakers, carpenters, goldsmiths and others.

All the above cited and many other historical facts serve to confirm the opinion that during the first fifteen centuries of their life in diaspora the great majority of the Jews earned their living by the toil of their hands. In

Poland even at the beginning of the 19th century the number of Jewish craftsmen were three times as big as that of Jewish merchants. In 1815 almost all the tailors, hatters and furriers in Poland were Jews as well as most of the locksmiths and fitters. The picture was different only in France, England and Germany. In this countries the economic policy of their respective governments forced the Jews into commerce and finance.

Summing up we may draw a definite conclusion, that in course of the first millenium of our era the great majority of the Jews were engaged in agriculture and various crafts. With the transference of the Jewish centre in Europe commerce begins to play a more important role in the economic structure of the Jews, but up to the 16th century handicraft was considered their chief occupation. Commerce was predominant only at certain periods and in certain places.

But the picture of the professional structure of the Jews will not be complete without mentioning the continuous war waged against Jewish labour. Sometimes this struggle took shape of mass demonstrations and riots, sometimes of legislative restrictions. The process of this struggle was always the same: first the population protested against Jewish labour and the Jews bought their privileges at a very high price. Then the pressure of the population became stronger and their privileges were withdrawn. The Jewish craftsmen of the Majorca island thus paid a special annual tax, but beginning from the 14th century they were entirely prohibited to work in the textile industry.
(To be continued)

First General Meeting
of the Newly Appointed SACRA
(Continued from page 1)

SACRA will undoubtedly be able to see their efforts take concrete results and achieve the ultimate aims, while the standard of SACRA, being coordinated with the Shanghai Stateless Refugee Bureau, will automatically produce smooth co-operation towards achievement of the relief work. In this connection all members of SACRA must bear in mind that necessary steps will be taken against all those who fail to do their duty, thereby hindering the progress of SACRA's undertakings.

Wrong compassion

"The Shanghai Stateless Refugee Bureau have so far taken a very lenient, in fact too lenient, attitude towards law breakers" continued Mr. Kubota: "Up to March 20th no punishment was meted out against them and only 3 persons were arrested, all three of them charged with faking passports, felony, etc. But it must be borne in mind that now, after an unduly long time had been given to all to conclude their duty, it is deemed necessary to take more rigorous steps and it is wrong to have any false compassion for such persons."

The arrogance of the Polish Refugees

"It is very regrettable to say", remarked Mr. Kubota in this connection, "that most of the present offenders, if not all of them, are of Polish

origin. We do not deny that they are Polish citizens but the Authorities here have compassionately considered to treat them as stateless, due to their actual statelessness, and not as enemy nationals, in which case their properties would have been subject to confiscation, etc. according to the law. Notwithstanding this special consideration, they have continually reacted most regrettably and badly annoyed the Authorities, hindering the proper carrying out of the Proclamation issued by the Military Authorities.

Misconceived Charity Organisations

The new SACRA, repeated Mr. T. Kubota, is organised to supervise all Jewish organisations in co-ordination with the Authorities and therefore he has taken the chair as Honorary President with the above view. As such, he declared that he wished to give all members as much freedom and protection as possible, with real effort to assist in SACRA's work of leadership, while all organisations will carry out their various duties most industriously. But, at the same time, he wishes that all organisations within or without the Area will actively and voluntarily co-operate with SACRA and assist in their work, avoiding unnecessary friction, and annoyance by petty personal reasons.

Charity is beyond doubt

necessary for those who are completely helpless and unable to work, but it would be a great error if charity is given without proper consideration and deliberation.

Efforts appreciated

Concluding, Mr. Kubota forewarned the Committee members of SACRA that their task is not an easy one. He stated "Your work started with difficulties and many hardships must be overcome-it may even end with difficulties but I can state that your efforts will not go unnoticed but will be fully appreciated and valued by my Government.

"You have already received very wide recognition of your work and I believe you will be able to achieve even greater appreciation with your future untiring efforts. I request the Committee members to work out detailed plans, and expect you to do your utmost for your people.

Vote of thanks

Upon conclusion of the speech by Mr. T. Kubota,

which was ably translated by Dr. Cohn, the Chairman of the Administration, the Committee unanimously accepted amidst general applause the move made by Mr. Kovner, Honorary Secretary of the Administration, to thank Mr. Kubota for his acceptance of the Presidency, thereby giving us his invaluable assistance and guidance.

Appointments

All the present members of the new SACRA Committee, have received official appointments. The letter of appointment reads as follows: "You are hereby appointed to serve as member of the Committee of the Shanghai Ashkenazi Collaborating Relief Association and your esteemed presence is requested at the first meeting of the new Committee to be held on...at..."

The letters of appointment were signed by Secretary General Mr. M. Kano and Hon. Chairman Dr. A.J. Cohn by order of Mr. T. Kubota, President.

(Bulletin No. 2)

我们的生活
1944年5月5日，星期五。

犹太人的职业结构
作者：E. Kayfman 博士

我们经常听到这样的抱怨，即人们对古代和中世纪犹太人的经济及职业结构知之甚少或一无所知。据一些学者称，我们缺乏统计数据，因此缺乏可靠的信息。但是，虽然确实没有这些时期的统计数据可用，但其他民族在这方面的情况并不比我们好，然而我们却了解他们过去的经济结构。同样地，我们也可以据此判断过去犹太人的经济结构。Karo、Uster 等人的著作早已证明这样一个事实：在我们时代的第一个千年里，犹太人不仅从事各种职业，而且其中绝大多数人依靠耕种土地和从事不同手工艺为生。尽管缺乏适当的统计数据，但仍有足够的材料支持上述结论。

著名历史学家约瑟夫斯（Joseph）强调指出，犹太人与埃及人和迦南人不同，后者的主要职业是贸易；他还提到，雇佣奴隶并非犹太人的习俗；这两点暗示足以让我们对当时犹太人的经济状况得出结论，尽管他并未向我们提供统计数据。同样，当我们在《塔木德》（Sukko 页 51, 72）中读到关于亚历山大港奢华会堂的描述，并且只遇到对手工匠的提及之时，我们可以从中得出结论：在埃及流散地的犹太人中，手工艺是主要的收入来源。其他《塔木德》资料有助于让我们毫无疑问地确信，在《塔木德》时期，犹太人主要从事土地耕作和手工艺。Goldschmidt 得出了同样的结论，并断言当时的犹太人不是一个商业民族。接下来的几个世纪也是如此。巴比伦的犹太人也大多从事农业和手工艺。直到8世纪初，他们才开始涉足商业领域。穆罕默德时代的阿拉伯犹太人大多是农民和工匠，贸易在其经济结构中所占比重微乎其微。直到十世纪的拜占庭犹太人主要从事农业，只有少数人从事工业和手工艺。从著名的犹太旅行家图德拉的拉比本杰明（Rabbi Benjamin of Tudela）和雷根斯堡的拉比佩塔希亚（Rabbi Petahia of Ratisbon）的描述以及其他来源中，我们了解到，直到十四世纪中叶，生活在东方、处于十字军和哈里发统治下的犹太人大多是农民和工匠。据本杰明称，这也适用于生活在希腊及其岛屿上的犹太人。在16世纪的西西里，大多数犹太人是手工艺人。在此方面，值得注意的是，1492年，当犹太人被驱逐出西班牙，且该命令也适用于西西里时，该国的基督徒向政府请愿，允许犹太人留下，以使西西里的工业免于崩溃，因为西西里的大多数锁匠、造船木匠和石匠都是犹太人。圣托马斯·阿奎那（St. Thomas Aquina）也证实了大多数意大利犹太人是工人的事实。罗马存有17世纪初的官方记录，其中提到，在91名犹太家庭户主中，有50人是手工艺人。

在西班牙，约有十二种不同的手工艺被认为主要由犹太人从事。在萨拉戈萨的犹太区，存在着整条街道的皮货商、鞋匠、木匠、金匠等。

以上引用的以及许多其他历史事实都证实了这样一种观点：在流散生活的前十五个世纪中，绝大多数犹太人依靠双手的辛勤劳动谋生。在

波兰，即使在19世纪初，犹太手工艺人的数量也是犹太商人的三倍。1815年，波兰几乎所有的裁缝、帽商和皮货商都是犹太人，大多数锁匠和装配工也是如此。只有在法国、英国和德国，情况有所不同。在这些国家，各自政府的经济政策迫使犹太人从事商业和金融业。

综上所述，我们可以得出一个明确的结论：在我们时代的第一个千年过程中，绝大多数犹太人从事农业和各种手工艺。随着犹太中心转移到欧洲，商业开始在犹太人的经济结构中发挥更重要的作用，但直到16世纪，手工艺仍被视为他们的主要职业。商业仅在特定时期和特定地点占据主导地位。

但是，如果不提及针对犹太劳工进行的持续斗争，犹太人的职业结构图景就不完整。有时这种斗争表现为大规模示威和骚乱，有时表现为立法限制。这一斗争的过程始终如一：首先，民众抗议犹太劳工，犹太人则以极高的代价购买他们的特权。随后，民众的压力增大，他们的特权被收回。马略卡岛（Majorca）的犹太手工艺人因此缴纳特别的年度税款，但从14世纪开始，他们被完全禁止在纺织行业工作。
（待续）

新任命之 SACRA 第一次全体会议
（接第1版）

SACRA 无疑能够看到其努力取得具体成果并实现最终目标，而 SACRA 的标准与上海无国籍难民局相协调，将自动促成救济工作顺利合作。在这方面，SACRA 的所有成员必须牢记，将对所有未能履行职责、从而阻碍 SACRA 事业进展的人采取必要措施。

错误的怜悯

“上海无国籍难民局迄今为止对违法者采取了非常宽容、事实上是过于宽容的态度，”久保田先生继续说道：“截至3月20日，未对他们实施任何惩罚，仅逮捕了3人，这三人都被指控伪造护照、重罪等。但必须牢记，现在，在给予所有人过长的时间以履行其职责之后，认为有必要采取更严厉的措施，对此类人抱有错误的怜悯是错误的。”

波兰难民的傲慢

“令人遗憾的是，”久保田先生就此 remarked，“目前的违法者，如果不是全部的话，大多数是波兰

裔。我们不否认他们是波兰公民，但当局出于同情，考虑到他们实际的无国籍状态，将他们视为无国籍人士而非敌国国民对待，否则根据法律，他们的财产将被没收等。尽管有这种特殊考虑，他们的反应仍然极其令人遗憾，并严重惹恼了当局，阻碍了军事当局发布的公告的正常执行。

误解的慈善组织

新的 SACRA，久保田 T. 先生重申，是为了在当局协调下监督所有犹太组织而成立的，因此他本着上述观点担任名誉主席。为此，他声明希望尽可能给予所有成员自由和保护，并真正努力协助 SACRA 的领导工作，同时所有组织都将最勤勉地履行其各项职责。但是，与此同时，他希望区域内外的所有组织都能积极自愿地与 SACRA 合作，协助其工作，避免因琐碎的个人原因造成不必要的摩擦和烦恼。

慈善对于

那些完全无助且无法工作的人来说无疑是必要的，但如果在不经过适当考虑和深思熟虑的情况下给予慈善，那将是一个巨大的错误。

努力受到赞赏

最后，久保田先生警告 SACRA 委员会成员，他们的任务并不轻松。他表示：“你们的工作始于困难，必须克服许多艰难困苦——甚至可能以困难告终，但我可以声明，你们的努力不会被忽视，并将得到我国政府的充分赞赏和重视。

“你们的工作已经获得了广泛的认可，我相信通过未来不懈的努力，你们将获得更大的赞誉。我要求委员会成员制定详细计划，并期望你们为本族人民竭尽全力。

致谢

在行政主席 Cohn 博士熟练翻译完久保田 T. 先生的讲话后，

委员会在热烈的掌声中一致通过了由行政荣誉秘书 Kovner 先生提出的动议，感谢久保田先生接受主席职务，从而为我们提供了宝贵的协助和指导。

任命

新 SACRA 委员会的所有现任成员均已收到正式任命书。任命书内容如下：“兹任命您担任上海阿什肯纳兹联合救济协会（Shanghai Ashkenazi Collaborating Relief Association）委员会委员，敬请阁下出席定于……在……举行的新委员会第一次会议……”

任命书由秘书长 M. Kano 先生和荣誉主席 A.J. Cohn 博士根据主席久保田 T. 先生的命令签署。

（第2号公报）

SUBJECT: Resignation of the Chairman of "Kitchen Fund"
It is learnt that the chairman of the
Kitchen Fund, Dr.E.Bergglas has resigned from his post

July 1942, as from April 4th,1944. His duties will

for Mr.Bergglas' resignation is bad health, but is
also believed this step is partly motivated by diffi-
culties which Dr.Bergglas had in representing the
Kitchen Fund at the S'hai Stateless Refugee Affairs
Bureau.

氏名 Name in Full
ユツセム
Julia M.M.
性別 Sex m./f.
生年月日 Date of Birth 8-8-09. 35 .
現居住證 國籍 Nationality Ger. Jew. Not.
現住所 Present Address 497 Hamilton Road Julia Room No.
申請目的 Object / Occupation: Sales man. Business Hours: 110 Szechuen Road. Former Occupation: Merchant.
來滬年月日 Date of Arrival 9-7-39 on S.S. "..."
出生地 Place of Birth Fuerth, Germ.
來滬前居住地 Residents Before Arrival Berlin.
居住期間 Length of 7 ys.
宗教 Religion Jewish
所屬教會 Church Synag. Jüd. Kult. Gem.
所在地 (Address) 11 Gen. Foch Rd.
諸證明書 Identification Documents (旅券, 出生, 結婚, 其他) (Passport, Birth, Marriage, etc.) I/ Foreigner's ID. II/ Cert. of Birth in Berlin on 20-4-09. III/ ... IV/ ... V/ ... VI/ ... VII/ ... VIII/ ... IX/ ... X/ ...
家族及親籍 (Family and Relatives) None in Shanghai.
職歷·生計 Short History of Life (in chronological Order) and economical condition at present. Born in Fuerth of Jewish parents. 1899 - 1905 Frequent schools. 1905 - 1908 Apprentice in an Import & Export Co. 1908 - 1911 in London and Paris employed in offices as accountant. 1911 - 1913 in various firms. 1913 - 1915 was employed as correspondent in his uncle's furniture company in Fuerth. 1913- 1914 proceeded as representative in his father's firm (mirror production) to New-York, Chicago and other towns in America. 1914- 1918 in German army on French front during the War. 1919-1927 had his own Export business in Nuremberg. 1927-1933 Accountant in a firm in Java (Loerboya). 1933- 1939 representative of a Textile Co. in Berlin.
學歷及語學 Education and Knowledge of Languages. Real School in Fuerth. Speak German, English, French, Dutch and Italian.
調查官所見及署名 Comment and Remarks. Arrived in Shanghai alone and was a commission agent for Textile Trading in Hamilton House No. 263 Room 19. Up to the present time representative Eastern Leather Co. 110 Szechuen Road. Room No. 70. Receives $1500 per month. At about 9.00 p.m. on 10-3-44 he was together with Felix Rosenthal in the "Eronee" Cafe on E. Seward Road partaking coffee. The authorities arrived and took away the Resid. Cert. No card playing was in progress. D.I. Investigation Officer

家族及親屬 上海無親屬。
職歷·生計 簡歷（按時間順序）及目前經濟狀況。出生於菲爾特，父母為猶太人。1899 - 1905 就讀各類學校。1905 - 1908 在一家進出口公司當學徒。1908 - 1911 在倫敦和巴黎受僱於辦公室擔任會計。1911 - 1913 在各家公司任職。1913 - 1915 在菲爾特其叔父的家具公司擔任通訊員。1913- 1914 作為其父親公司（鏡子生產）的代表前往紐約、芝加哥及美國其他城鎮。1914- 1918 戰爭期間在德國軍隊服役於法國前線。1919-1927 在紐倫堡經營自己的出口業務。1927-1933 在爪哇（Loerboya）的一家公司擔任會計。1933- 1939 擔任柏林一家紡織公司的代表。
學歷及語學 菲爾特實科中學。會說德語、英語、法語、荷蘭語和意大利語。

職歷·生平 Short History of Life (in chronological Order) and economical condition at present.
Born in Vienna of Jewish parents. 1907-1919 attended schools.
1919-1939 (March) worked as waiter in various restaurants in Vienna.

Remarks of Investigating Officer

At about 8.30 p.m. on the 26th of March his brother who ar-
rived here, told me that he had seen his brother's wife and two children.
He said that his brother had been arrested by the Japanese police and
taken to the Nanking Road Police Station. He also said that his brother
had been beaten up by the Japanese police and was now in hospital.
He further stated that his brother's wife and children were living
in a small room in the back of a shop on Nanking Road. He said
that they had no food and were very hungry. He asked me if I could
help them. I told him that I would do what I could.

J.I.

According to information
received from Mr. ......... , a refugee,

landlord that he must vacate his premises
and that he is being forced to do so. He
states that he has no other place to go and
that he is unable to find accommodation
elsewhere. He further states that he has
been living in this house for some time and
that he has always paid his rent regularly.
He states that he has never caused any
trouble and that he has always been a good
tenant. He states that he is willing to pay
any reasonable rent that may be demanded
of him. He states that he has a wife and
children who are dependent upon him and
that he is unable to support them if he is
forced to leave his present home. He states
that he has made every effort to find other
accommodation but has been unsuccessful.
He states that he is willing to do anything
that may be required of him in order to
remain in his present home. He states that
he has always been a law-abiding citizen
and that he has never been in trouble with
the police. He states that he is willing to
give any security that may be required of
him in order to remain in his present home.
He states that he has always been a good
neighbor and that he has never caused any
trouble to anyone. He states that he is
willing to do anything that may be required
of him in order to remain in his present
home. He states that he has always been a
law-abiding citizen and that he has never
been in trouble with the police. He states
that he is willing to give any security that
may be required of him in order to remain
in his present home. He states that he has
always been a good neighbor and that he
has never caused any trouble to anyone.

上海公共租界工部局警務處。
報告
239
1944年3月28日
分局........................................ 檔案號.................... 日期....................

主題： ........................................

據從一名難民……先生處獲得的情報，
該難民目前仍居住在法租界，繼續以包租
形式進行轉租。他稱，房東告知他必須搬
離其住所，且他正被迫如此行事。他稱，
他無其他去處，且無法在其他地方找到住
所。他進一步稱，他在該房屋已居住一段
時間，且一直按時繳納租金。他稱，他從
未惹過麻煩，一直是一名好租客。他稱，

The paper furthermore contains an appeal by the Jewish Gemeinde for donations towards a fund for these unfortunate refugees, who lost their homes through the fire which started in house No.9, 343 Ward Rd, a Chinese laundry, in the morning of March 14th. This refers to 15 families or 74 individuals, living in the adjoining houses Nos. 5, 7, and 11. The appeal gives already a name list of 16 persons who contributed a total of $ 11.650.-

The news report on the same subject mentions very favourably the assistance rendered throughout the whole occurrence by the Foreign Aid Corps - Jewish Section. Persons affected by the fire and entirely without shelter were temporarily taken care of by the Kitchen Fund.

SUBJECT: Further re: Cancellation of S.A.C.R.A. Allotments

（批：蘇井部長 月不報告 次員 科）

Enquiries with regard to the above subject reveal, that S.A.C.R.A. Notification No. 42 refers to holders of allotments in respect of Lane 542 Ward Rd. It does not affect holders of extentions.

According to a list compiled by S.A.C.R.A. in October 1943, there were still 154 persons residing outside the designated area and waiting for their quarters in the above lane to be ready. This figure may have decreased slightly because of the possibility that some allotment holders have found quarters of their own and have moved into the designated area without informing the S.A.C.R.A.

Since the middle of 1943, S.A.C.R.A. is paying rent for 63 houses in the above lane, 542 Ward Rd, but to date only 4 of the houses were evacuated by their former Chinese tenants. These 4 houses are in such a poor condition, that people will not be able to move in there. In other S.A.C.R.A. leased premises, all rooms are occupied. In addition, S.A.C.R.A. has leased a building with 12 rooms at 266 Macgregor Rd (inside the designated area) which will be evacuated shortly by its present tenants. There they expect to house about 40 persons, but they do not know where to quarter the remainder.

In connection with the S.A.C.R.A.'s difficulties in finding quarters for the former allotment holders, it is learnt that recently a number of refugees who reside already in the designated area have applied to the S.A.C.R.A. for rooms. The reason is that their Chinese chieftenants demand their removal which with the present housing conditions in the designated area is nearly impossible.

D. S.
Gilhau

O i/c Foreign Affairs
Intelligence Dept.

主題：關於撤銷 S.A.C.R.A. 配額的進一步情況

（批：蘇井部長 月度報告 次員 科）

關於上述主題的查詢顯示，S.A.C.R.A. 第42號通知涉及華德路542弄配額持有者。它不影響延期持有者。

根據 S.A.C.R.A. 於1943年10月編製的名單，仍有154人居住在指定區域之外，等待上述弄堂內的住房準備就緒。由於一些配額持有者可能已自行找到住處並搬入指定區域而未通知 S.A.C.R.A.，這一數字可能略有減少。

自1943年中以來，S.A.C.R.A. 一直為上述華德路542弄的63棟房屋支付租金，但迄今為止，只有4棟房屋的原中國租客搬離。這4棟房屋狀況極差，人們無法搬入其中。在其他 S.A.C.R.A. 租賃的場所中，所有房間均已住滿。此外，S.A.C.R.A. 已在麥格理戈路266號（位於指定區域內）租賃了一棟擁有12個房間的建築，現有租客即將搬離。他們預計在那裡安置約40人，但不知道將其餘人員安置何處。

鑑於 S.A.C.R.A. 在為原配額持有者尋找住處方面遇到的困難，據悉，最近一些已居住在指定區域內的難民已向 S.A.C.R.A. 申請房間。原因是他們的中國二房東要求他們搬離，而在指定區域目前的住房條件下，這幾乎是不可能的。

D. S.
Gilhau

外事科負責人
情報科

4-7-1944

Extract from S'hai Jewish Chronicle of Febr. 4th, 1944

The S'hai Jewish Chronicle of Jan. 24t, 1944 contains
an article, entitled "Important Announcement for Emigrants"
The article states preparations are being made which will
affect favourably the living conditions of refugees within
the designate area. It is furthermore said that the prepara-
tions are guided by the Shanghai Stateless Refugee Affairs
Bureau and will be concluded at the end of the current week.
Finally, the article which does not give any details regard-
ing the matters in preparation, recommends a close study of
announcements which will be made on Sunday, Febr. 27th, through
the S'hai Jewish Chronicle.

Enquiries with regard to the above article reveal that
it has been inspired by the Jewish Gemeinde and refers to
the formation of a "Emigrants Residents Union", the honorary
chairman of which will be Mr. Kubota. Membership with this
organization, which aims to improve the living conditions
of refugees, will be compulsory for all stateless refugees
affected by the Proclamation of Febr. 18th, 1943. An application
for registration of the "Emigrants Residents Union", consist-
ing of a Committee of Mr. Kubota as honorary chairman and 3
executives of the Jewish Gemeinde as committee members,
has already been received by this Section. Further particu-
lars regarding the activities of the Committee will be sub-
mitted.

（批：Jew）
（签名：S. Ulsai）

摘自1944年2月4日《上海犹太纪事报》

1944年1月24日的《上海犹太纪事报》刊登了一篇题为“给移民的重要公告”的文章。文章称，正在进行的准备工作将有利于指定区域内难民的生活条件。此外还称，这些准备工作由上海无国籍难民事务局指导，并将于本周结束时完成。最后，该文章未提供有关筹备事项的任何细节，建议读者仔细研读将于2月27日（星期日）通过《上海犹太纪事报》发布的公告。

就上述文章进行的查询显示，该文章系受犹太公会（Jewish Gemeinde）启发而作，指的是成立一个“移民居民联合会”，其名誉主席将由久保田（Kubota）先生担任。凡受1943年2月18日公告影响的所有无国籍难民，均必须加入这个旨在改善难民生活条件的组织。本处已收到一份关于注册“移民居民联合会”的申请，该联合会委员会由久保田先生任名誉主席，三名犹太公会高管任委员。关于该委员会活动的更多详情将另行呈报。

（批注：犹太人）
（签名：S. Ulsai）

Station Wayside File No. 21/- Date January, 20th, 1944.

SUBJECT: Re Advertisment appearing in the "Shanghai Jewish Chronicle" of Jan. 20th, 1944

In the above issue of the S'hai Jewish Chronicle an advertisement appeared to the effect that in connection with the forthcoming change of residents certificates, 3 passphotos will be required. The advertisement was put in by the "Quick Photo", 625 Ward Rd owned by Mr. Gustav Wohl, stateless refugee, residing at 655/38 Tongshan Rd.

In this connection the office of the newspaper was approached by the Foreign Affairs Section Headquarters in order to obtain information from where the advertiser has received knowledge that 3 pictures would be required, as no official notification to this effect has appeared. It was consequently learned that Wohl, according to his statement to a messenger from the newspaper, Werner Jelewski, had explained that his knowledge came from a telephone enquiry to the Western Police, Tel. No. 38156, and an information from the Pao Chia Office Wayside Station mentioning the name of Warschauer.

Acting on instructions, D.S. Chale brought G. Wohl to the Detective Office Wayside Station, where he was questioned and a written statement taken from him. The messenger of the Jewish Chronicle, Jalewski and Mr. Warschauer were also called to the office and crossexamined and statements were taken from them.

韦赛德巡捕房 档案号 21/- 日期 1944年1月20日。

主题：关于1944年1月20日《上海犹太纪事报》上刊登的广告

在上述一期《上海犹太纪事报》中，刊登了一则广告，大意是鉴于即将更换居住证，需要三张护照照片。该广告由“快照相馆”（Quick Photo）投放，店主为无国籍难民古斯塔夫·沃尔（Gustav Wohl）先生，住址为同山路655/38号。

为此，总部外事科联系了报社办公室，以获取广告商从何得知需要三张照片的信息，因为此前并未发布此类官方通知。随后获悉，据沃尔向报社信使维尔纳·耶莱夫斯基（Werner Jelewski）陈述，他的消息来源是致电西区巡捕房（电话号38156），以及来自韦赛德巡捕房保甲办公室的一条提及华沙尔（Warschauer）名字的信息。

奉命行事，侦探沙莱（Chale）将G. 沃尔带至韦赛德巡捕房侦探室，对其进行了讯问并取得了书面供词。《犹太纪事报》的信使耶莱夫斯基和华沙尔先生也被召至办公室接受交叉讯问，并取得了他们的供词。

根据上述调查，案情如下：

沃尔在报纸上读到即将签发新的公民证书的消息后

（左侧竖排手写批注，从右至左）
东部地区进行新登记之
行列乃敌性宽幅客人真之凡俗间也
确认被告知此事
注：该所告是否汇与居保甲有关？

（批注：沃尔 cron / 犹太人。）

Jan.20th,1944
Statement taken from, Mr.Gustav Wohl. stateless Refugee,
residing at 635/38 Tongshan Rd ____________________ by U.S.Schaie

In the newspapers Shanghai Jewish Chronicle, Shanghai
Times, and Ostasiatischer Lloyd, I read a report to the effect
that shortly new citizenship certificates will be issued. This
report was said to come from the Central Press Service. From
customers I learned that the foreigners in the Western Area
have received already forms which are to be returned with
pictures to the Police as quickly as possible. Thereupon I
telephoned to the Western Area Police. Tel.No.23156 , from where
I received the answer that the foreigner already have to appear
with pictures. regarding the Chinese I was told that the date
has not yet been fixed.

My messengers who visit daily many (of my photo receiving) shops in all parts of the
the city, were informed by the proprietors of the shops that new
residents certificates would be issued soon. This goes back many
weeks ago. Then I tried to ascertain whether this was true or not
and I went to Police Headquarters to ask. I went to room 207
and spoke to a foreigner who I later learned it to be Mr.Schaie, and
who in turn asked a Japanese gentleman. I was told that cards are
in preparation, but could learn no date.

Moreover, Mr. Warschauer who I know works at the Pao Chia
Office Wayside Station, ordered pictures for himself and his wife
12 pictures. when I asked him whether a date for the issue of the
new passes had been fixed, I could not learn an exact date. This
was before the publication in the newspaper.

I decided to advertize now, because I received order from
customers in the Western Area and wanted to become known with
others who didn't know me and who need pictures.

I do not remember the exact dates of the above occurrences.
This is my true statement

Gustav Wohl
(signature)

1944年1月20日
对古斯塔夫·沃尔先生的供词记录，无国籍难民，
居住于同山路635/38号 ____________________ 由 U.S. Schaie 记录

我在《上海犹太纪事报》、《字林西报》和《德文新报》（Ostasiatischer Lloyd）上读到一则报道，大意是即将签发新的公民证书。据说该报道来自中央通讯社。我从顾客那里得知，西区的外国人已经收到了表格，需尽快连同照片一并交回警察局。于是我致电西区巡捕房，电话号23156，得到的答复是外国人已经需要携带照片前往。关于中国人，我被告知日期尚未确定。

我每天派信使走访全市许多（接收我照片的）店铺，店主们告诉我很快将签发新的居住证。这已是数周前的事了。随后我试图查证此事真假，便去警察总局询问。我去了207房间，与一名外国人交谈，后来得知他是沙莱（Schaie）先生，他又询问了一位日本绅士。我被告知证件正在筹备中，但未获知具体日期。

此外，我知道在韦赛德巡捕房保甲办公室工作的华沙尔（Warschauer）先生为自己和妻子订购了12张照片。当我问他签发新通行证的日子是否已定时，我无法得知确切日期。这是在报纸刊登之前的事。

我决定现在做广告，因为我收到了西区顾客的订单，并希望让其他不认识我但需要照片的人知道我的存在。

我不记得上述事件的确切日期。
这是我的真实陈述

古斯塔夫·沃尔
（签名）

STATEMENT.

Werner Galawski, age 15, s/male, Germ. Jew. Ref. , apprentice with
the Shanghai Jewish Chronicle , residing 1107/49 East Broadway.

I Werner Galowski herewith state that at about 11.30 a.m. on the
20-th of January, 1944,I was sent to Gustav Wohl, photographer, 635/ 38
Tongshan Road in order to ascertain from whom had he received the in-
formation regarding the three pictures are wanted for Residents
Certificates according to his advertisement in the Jewish Chronicle.

G. Wohl told me from the dark room, where he was working at the
time that he had asked about it at the Fao Chih Office Wayside Station
where Warshauer is employed , where it was said to him that three
photos will be required for the New Resident Certificates. Also that
he had telephoned to the Western Police, taking the number of the
telephone in the Telephone Book under the letter "W" not under "Po-
lice", who also confirmed that three photos will be required for this
purpose. I then proceeded to the Office of the Jewish Chronicle and
passed this information to the office manageress Miss Anna Katz.

This is my true statement.

W Galawski.

维尔纳·加拉夫斯基（Werner Galawski），15岁，男性，德国犹太难民，《上海犹太纪事报》学徒，居住于百老汇路1107/49号。

本人维尔纳·加拉夫斯基特此声明，1944年1月20日上午11时30分左右，我被派往摄影师古斯塔夫·沃尔处（同山路635/38号），以查明他根据其在《犹太纪事报》上的广告所称的关于居住证需要三张照片的信息是从何处获得的。

G. 沃尔从他当时正在工作的暗房里告诉我，他曾向韦赛德巡捕房保甲办公室（Fao Chih Office，原文拼写错误，应为Pao Chia）询问，华沙尔（Warshauer）受雇于此，那里的人告诉他新居住证需要三张照片。他还说他致电了西区巡捕房，他在电话簿“W”字母下而非“Police”下查找的电话号码，对方也确认为此目的需要三张照片。随后我前往《犹太纪事报》办公室，将此信息转达给办公室经理安娜·卡茨（Anna Katz）小姐。

这是我的真实陈述。

W. 加拉夫斯基。

I herewith state that about 10 days ago Gustav Wohl, photographer came to the Pao Chia Office Wayside Station in order to change his Resident Certificate which was a little broke, when I told him that same was not yet so bad and anyhow very soon the Resident Certificates will be changed.

I ordered for myself and my wife some photographs to be made by G. Wohl, because I need them , but I never mentioned to him that these photos are required for a Residents Certificate. These photos were received from him about the 15-th of January.

SUBJECT: Renewal of Blue Special Passes

Through the Chief Jewish Chronicle of Jan.

informs that it will be in renewing blue special passes

considered as of dubious nature if more than two desti-

are demanded.

All statements made in connection with

外事股
情报科分站    档案号    日期 1944年1月15日

主题：蓝色特别通行证的换发

通过1944年1月9日的《犹太纪事报》（Jewish Chronicle），上海公共租界工部局警务处外事局通知，将于1944年1月11日星期五换发蓝色特别通行证。此处所指为将于1944年2月10日到期的特别通行证。此类通行证占已签发通行证的大多数，数量超过5000张。

在同一通知中，该局告知，为获取特别通行证而变更职业是不被允许的，违者将视情况予以处罚。

此外还指出，诸如推销员、仅以此谋生者、经理或代理人等职业，如果需要前往两个以上的目的地或要求更长的工作时间，则被视为性质可疑。

所有与特别通行证事务相关的陈述均需经书面证明核实，并由负责人签字。

（签名：J. Ullman）

K 20/1.    POLICE BUREAU
           FOR COMMENT
           (批：ENCLOSURE)
Shanghai Ashkenazi Collaborating Relief Association,
137 Peking Road, 2nd Floor,
Shanghai, December 20th, 1943.

The Secretary,
First District Administration,
Shanghai.

Dear Sirs:
    The Relief Committee of S.A.C.R.A. hereby applies for
permission to make a collection of old clothing during Sunday, Monday
and Tuesday, December 26th, 27th and 28th. This clothing is intended
for distribution among the poorer classes of Refugees living at present
in the Designated Area. The collection will be made by seven groups of
our young men and girls, who will call on the dates specified at the
homes of Jewish families in the First and Eighth Districts, in accord-
dance with lists attached hereto. No collection whatsoever will be
made on the streets. The boys and girls, whose names are shown on the
attached list, will use their own bicycles to visit the homes and it
is hoped that the response to this appeal will be generous.
    Trusting that this permit will be granted and assuring you
of our best co-operation at all times, we remain dear Sirs.
                        Yours faithfully,
                Shanghai Ashkenazi Collaborating
                        Relief Association.

        Chairman.                     Secretary.

敬启者：
    S.A.C.R.A.救济委员会特此申请许可，于12月26日、27日和28日（星期日、星期一和星期二）进行旧衣物募集。这些衣物旨在分发给目前居住在指定区域内的较贫困难民阶层。募集工作将由我们的七组青年男女执行，他们将根据随函附上的名单，在指定日期拜访第一区和第八区的犹太家庭住所。绝不会在街道上进行任何募集。名单上列名的男孩和女孩将使用自己的自行车走访各户，希望各界对此呼吁能慷慨响应。
    相信此许可证将获得批准，并保证我们始终全力合作，此致
                        您忠实的，
                上海阿什肯纳兹联合
                        救济协会

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
239
Foreign Affairs Section
Station Intelligence Dept. File No. Date 3 - Feb - 1943.
SUBJECT: Extract from the S'hai Jewish Chronicle
concerning Gerhard Loutsch C.R.O.5587
The following notice appeared in the Dec.9th
edition of the S'hai Jewish Chronicle:-
"Communication from the Stateless Refugee Bureau
A Warning to the Public
The Stateless Refugee Bureau informs as follows:
Gerhard Leutsch, age 59, has been arrested by the Police
for larceny and for being without a fixed abode. Further
more, it has become evident, that Loutsch is to be pu-
nished by the competent authorities for violation of
the Proclamation because he knew that he was subject
to the Proclamation yet failed to move into the desi-
gnated area. At present he is detained and severest
punishment will very soon be meted out to him."
FILE
The above notice is obviously meant to discou-
rage refugees from violating the regulations pertain-
ing to the Proclamation of Febr.18th,1943. It follows
an announcement previously issued by the above office
to the effect that the names of offenders will be pu-
blished. The above notice is the first of its kind.
O i'e Foreign Affairs Section
Intelligence Dept.

报告
239
外事科
分局情报部 档案号 日期 1943年2月3日。
主题：摘自《上海犹太纪事报》
关于格哈德·劳奇 (Gerhard Loutsch) C.R.O.5587
以下通告刊登于12月9日
版《上海犹太纪事报》：-
“无国籍难民局通讯
对公众的警告
无国籍难民局通报如下：
格哈德·洛伊奇 (Gerhard Leutsch)，59岁，已被警方
以盗窃罪及无固定住所罪逮捕。此外，
事实证明，劳奇将因违反
公告而受到主管当局的处罚，因为他明知自己受
该公告约束，却未搬入指定
区域。目前他已被拘留，最严厉的
惩罚将很快施加于他。”
存档
上述通告显然是为了阻
止难民违反1943年2月18日
公告的相关规定。此前该部门已发布公告，
称将公布违规者姓名。上述通告是此类通告中的
第一份。
外事科负责人
情报部

SUBJECT: Activities of the Economic Section of the Jewish Gemeinde in connection with the renewal of special passes

On Oct.10th and 11th, the Economic Section registered all persons who either had received or applied for special passes. Enquiries show that this was done for index purposes of the Shanghai Stateless Refugee Affairs Bureau.

When registration forms were handed in, a set of new forms were issued to those who wanted to obtain recommendations for the renewal of passes from the Economic Section. These forms, after having been filled in, are to be handed back to the Economic Section and are investigated by the latter. If the investigation shows that the pass has been rightly applied for, a recommendation is issued. The applicant then calls at the S.S.R.A.B., together with the recommendation and a letter of guarantee from the guarantor, in order to request a prolongation of the pass.

In a notification, issued by the Economic Section on Oct.12th, it is mentioned that this procedure applies to persons who require recommendations from the Economic Section, but it does not specify who actually requires them. The recent renewals of pink passes showed, that many passes were prolonged without such a recommendation.

主题：犹太公会经济部在更新特别通行证方面的活动

10月10日和11日，经济部对所有已收到或申请特别通行证的人员进行了登记。调查显示，此举是为了上海无国籍难民事务局的索引目的。

在提交登记表时，向那些希望从经济部获得通行证续期推荐的人发放了一套新表格。这些表格填写后需交回经济部，由后者进行调查。如果调查显示通行证申请合理，则出具推荐信。申请人随后携带推荐信及担保人的担保信前往上海无国籍难民事务局 (S.S.R.A.B.)，申请延长通行证有效期。

在经济部于10月12日发布的通知中，提到此程序适用于需要经济部推荐的人士，但未具体说明谁实际需要推荐。最近的粉色通行证续期情况显示，许多通行证的延期并未附带此类推荐。

SUBJECT: S.A.C.R.A. to Receive Refugee Donations on behalf of the Kitchen Fund

According to notifications in the Sept.6th edition of the S'hai Jewish Chronicle, the Kitchen Fund will cease to collect "Sponsorships", which were the regular donations of refugees towards the Kitchen Fund. One "Sponsorship" used to cost $ 100.- per month.

Instead of the former procedure, donations from Refugees will from now on go to the Relief Section of the S.A.C.R.A. which in this manner is to centralize the charity efforts of the whole Jewish population of Shanghai for the benefit of refugees.

According to the S.A.C.R.A.Notification No. 36, referring to the above subject, the entire Jewish population of Shanghai will have to make regular monthly contributions to the Relief Section of the S.A.C.R.A. Those who are expected to make contributions, will receive letters within the next few days. Payments have to be made without delay to the Relief Section of the S.A.C.R.A. Should anyone wish to object against the amounts to which his contribution has been assessed, he is to address himself to Mr.Kane at the 137 Peking Rd Office.

In this connection, it is learnt, that the amounts which refugees contributed to the Kitchen Fund, were little over $ 100.000.- , Through the above measure, it is expected to raise the sum to $ 250.000.-

O i/c Foreign Affairs Section
C & S Branch

主题：上海无国籍难民救济协会（S.A.C.R.A.）代表厨房基金接收难民捐款

根据9月6日版《上海犹太纪事报》（S'hai Jewish Chronicle）的通知，厨房基金将停止收取“赞助费”，即难民向厨房基金提供的常规捐款。一笔“赞助费”原为每月100元。

取代以往的做法，难民的捐款从现在起将交给上海无国籍难民救济协会（S.A.C.R.A.）的救济科，以此方式集中上海全体犹太居民的慈善努力，以造福难民。

根据涉及上述主题的上海无国籍难民救济协会第36号通知，上海全体犹太居民必须每月向上海无国籍难民救济协会的救济科缴纳定期捐款。预计需捐款者将在未来几天内收到信函。款项必须立即支付给上海无国籍难民救济协会救济科。若有人对其被评估的捐款金额有异议，应向北京路137号办公室的凯恩先生（Mr. Kane）提出。

据此获悉，难民此前向厨房基金捐赠的金额略超过100,000元。通过上述措施，预计将该金额提高至250,000元。

外事科主管
刑事侦缉处

（批：根據國際救濟部一九四一年獨太協會員約三百五十名之對華德路一三號所在避難民給食所資金トシテ本年九月一日、櫻機團生手代より以テ毎月二十五万ヅツ金セムコトヲ出シタル趣御參考迄と報告す。登記股 シヤイ都倉）

SUBJECT: Allotment Holders receiving Papers to enter
and leave the Designated Area

When after the begin of the segregation,
allotment holders were also instructed to get ready to
move into the designated area, the question arose how
they could identify themselves as allotment holders,
after having delivered their allotment papers to the
Muirhead Rd Office. This situation arose between the
date of application for removal papers at 70 Muirhead Rd
and their actual removal into the designated area. If
during this period, allotment holders still residing
outside the designated area want to enter the area,
they have repeatedly got into difficulties, not being
able to prove their residence outside the area.

In order to avoid these difficulties, the
S.A.C.R.A. published a notice on Aug.18th, as follows:
"Allotment holders who want to enter the designated area
will first call at the S.A.C.R.A.office,139 Peking Rd,
to receive a chit, in return for which they will recei-
ve a pass at the Muirhead Rdoffice to leave the desig-
nated area."

At that time it was probably possible to enter the area,
but not to leave it. Enquiries show now, that the proce-
dure adopted is that allotment holders who have handed
in their allotment certificate at Muirhead Rd, will
be issued with copies of their allotments by the S.A.C.
R.A., which will permit them to enter and leave the area
freely until the will have finally moved in.

（印：18.8.20）

主题：配额持有者领取进入和离开指定区域证件

在隔离开始后，配额持有者也接到指令准备迁入指定区域，此时出现了一个问题：他们在将配额文件交至缪尔黑德路（Muirhead Rd）办公室后，如何证明其配额持有者身份。这种情况发生在在缪尔黑德路70号申请迁移证之日与实际迁入指定区域之间。在此期间，仍居住在指定区域外的配额持有者若想进入该区域，会反复遇到困难，因为他们无法证明其在区域外的居住情况。

为避免这些困难，上海无国籍难民救济协会（S.A.C.R.A.）于8月18日发布如下通知：“希望进入指定区域的配额持有者，请先前往北京路139号上海无国籍难民救济协会办公室领取一张便条，凭此便条可在缪尔黑德路办公室领取离开指定区域的通行证。”

当时可能可以进入该区域，但不能离开。经查询，目前采用的程序是：已在缪尔黑德路上交配额证书的配额持有者，将由上海无国籍难民救济协会（S.A.C.R.A.）发给其配额证书的副本，允许他们在最终迁入之前自由进出该区域。

（印：1943年8月18日）
（批：1943年8月27日）

SUBJECT: The Situation of Refugees After the Start of
the Segregation on 18th, 1943

Through the coming into effect of the segregation, the situation of refugees inside the area has changed drastically. From the day when the date of segregation became known, purchases by merchants XXXX inside the area have been very small because they did not know whether they will be able to keep up their connections with outlying areas, where they used to sell their goods and products. Anybody forced to sell goods in the area for reasons of obtaining ready cash, will receive ridiculous prices, because at the very moment, merchants prefer to have some cash to buying goods, of which they do not know whether they will be able to sell them. Hardest hit are those small tradespeople and hawkers who lived from their day-to-day earnings. This class of people can already say until when their means will last and when they will have to apply for public charity. Due to these reasons, refugees are deeply concerned over the future of the inmates of the area. This question forms the topic of all conversations.

It is learnt, that the Jewish Gemeinde through its Economic Section will assist in the issue of passes over short periods. If a person has a legitimate reason to leave the area on one or several days, he makes an application at the Jewish Gemeinde. The latter forwards it to the 70 Muirhead Rd office and, after approval, issues it.

随着隔离措施的实施，区域内难民的处境发生了剧烈变化。从隔离日期公布之日起，区域内商人的采购量XXXX非常小，因为他们不知道能否维持与外围地区的联系，而他们过去正是在那些地区销售货物和产品。任何人若因需要现金而被迫在区域内出售货物，只能得到极低的价格，因为在此刻，商人宁愿持有现金，也不愿购买他们不确定能否售出的货物。受打击最重的是那些靠每日收入维生的小商贩和摊贩。这类人已经可以算出他们的积蓄能维持到何时，以及何时不得不申请公共救济。由于这些原因，难民对区域内居民的未来深感忧虑。这个问题成为了所有谈话的话题。

SUBJECT: 猶太地域內一般經濟概況
Financial Conditions of Refugee Families;
Weekly Economical and General Comment on
Businesses in Designated Area.

（批：Kayuga
Ryu
11
報
告
科）

Since May 19. 1943, the deadline for the removal of
Jewish and Stateless Refugees into the Designatedv Area, as
specified by the Proclamation of the Japanese Authorities in
Shanghai, many new businesses have sprung up in this area.
Ever since the first publication of the Proclamation,
on February 13, 1943, most of those who had businesses in the
Settlement and the French Concession immediately set about to
find premises in the designated area. According to some of these
refugees, those that removed right from the very beginning, didi
not have much difficulty in obtaining premises for living but as
the first month passed, many of them had to pay key money to get
houses and rooms. For key money, various sums ranging from Yen 300
to Yen 1000 was charged.
After their removal into the Area, these refugees at
once started making up their respective businesses. Those that
had provision shops outside of the Area, brought with them their
stocks of tinned goods, wines etc. Those that had bars, cafes and
restaurants brought with them their wines, furnitures etc. In most
cases the business people brought with them whatever they had.
Even brokers brought with them whatever goods they were hoarding
such as sugar, milk, powder straw-matting, mosquito incense, wines
tinned goods etc.
Shops were set up in a short space of time and in all
cases nearly, the decoration of the shops and arrangements of the
interiors were given to Jewish refugee carpenters. Only in a very
few cases was the work given to Chinese carpenters.
Most of the refugee business people did not seem to
be hard-pressed for cash and this is evidence that during their
few years stay in Shanghai they accumulated some profits. Only in
a few cases were complaints heard about the Proclamation. These
were where individuals or unsuccessful brokers were concerned. The
businesses in Hongkew district, the bars and cafes that once were
doing a good business with Japanese clients now hopefully expect
good business from Jewish and Stateless refugees. Up to the time
of writing, most establishments have fully completed their dec-
orations and have everything prepared to open their doors once the
licences have been issued to them. Those that have not been issued
with their respective licences are not doing any business as yet
but brokers, salesmen etc. are already busy transacting business.
Many doctors and surgeons have received premission to
stay out of the designated area for a few months, but despite this
a large number have already moved into the Area and have already
set up their business.
In most cases rentals for the premises leased by the
refugees are not high; Chinese type dwelling-houses which is the
most common type being leased for businesses, being rented from
$35 to $75 on the average and better type houses from $100 to $150
Rentals for shops range from $300 to $750 a month including the
living quarters.
Families are in most cases not so badly off, and, in
houses where they have moved to live in, are from four to eight
families. As a result of the new grocery stores that have been
opened in the new area, families will not find it difficult to
purchase commodities. Gardens and playgrounds have already been
opened up for the convenience of individuals during the summer
months and there are a number of cinemas that will be able to cater

主题：猶太地域內一般經濟概況
难民家庭财务状况；
指定区域内商业每周经济与总体评论。

（批：Kayuga
Ryu
11
報
告
科）

自1943年5月19日（即上海日本当局公告规定的犹太人和无国籍难民迁入指定区域的最后期限）以来，该地区涌现了许多新企业。自1943年2月13日首次公布该公告以来，大多数在公共租界和法租界拥有企业的人立即着手在指定区域寻找经营场所。据其中一些难民称，那些从一开始就搬迁的人在获得居住场所方面并没有太大困难，但随着第一个月过去，许多人不得不支付“顶费”（key money）才能获得房屋和房间。顶费金额从300日元到1000日元不等。

迁入该区域后，这些难民立即开始组建各自的企业。那些在区域外拥有食品店的人，带来了他们的罐头食品、酒类等库存。那些拥有酒吧、咖啡馆和餐馆的人，带来了他们的酒类、家具等。在大多数情况下，商人们带来了他们所有的一切。即使是经纪人也带来了他们囤积的各种货物，如糖、牛奶、粉状草席、蚊香、酒类、罐头食品等。

商店在短时间内建立起来，在几乎所有情况下，商店的装修和内部布置都交给了犹太难民木匠。只有在极少数情况下，工作才交给中国木匠。

大多数难民商人似乎并不缺乏现金，这证明他们在上海居住的几年里积累了一些利润。只有少数情况下听到对公告的抱怨。这些情况涉及个人或失败的经纪人。虹口地区的企业，那些曾经与日本客户生意兴隆的酒吧和咖啡馆，现在满怀希望地期待从犹太人和无国籍难民那里获得良好的生意。截至撰写本文时，大多数场所已完全完成装修，并准备好一旦获得执照即可开门营业。那些尚未获得相应执照的场所尚未开展任何业务，但经纪人、销售人员等已经在忙于进行交易。

许多医生和外科医生已获准在指定区域外停留数月，但尽管如此，大量人员已迁入该区域并已开展业务。

在大多数情况下，难民租赁场所的租金并不高；最常见的用于商业租赁的中式住宅，平均租金为35至75美元，较好的房屋租金为100至150美元。店铺租金范围为每月300至750美元，包括居住空间。

家庭在大多数情况下境况并非糟糕，在他们搬入居住的房屋中，通常有四到八个家庭合住。由于新区开设了许多新的杂货店，家庭购买商品并不会感到困难。花园和游乐场已在夏季月份为方便个人而开放，还有一些电影院能够满足

SUBJECT: Re-Opening of the Chusan Rd. Refugee(Jewish) Camp.

Since the opening of thefive camps for Jewish Refugees, no one who had a gaol record nor anyone who was of a known bad character was allowed to reside in any one of these camps. The reason for this decision was because the refugees with clean characters did not wish to mix with those who had prison records thereforeit was decided by the Kitchen Fund committee to find some sort of shelter for previously convicted refugees. For a time last year, these persons were accomodated in thepremises of the Salvation Army and the Kitchen Fund had to pay a daily fee of $1. per head. When some months ago no more accomodation was available at the Salvation Army, the Kitchen Fund was at a loss as to how to accomodate these persons. Since no other way out was found, the Kitchen Fund Committee accomodated these persons in third class Chinese hotels in Hongkew at the rate of $12 or $15 per head. This was too expensive for the Committee and also many of the refugees with good characters who were staying in camps objected to the fact that they, with no prison terms had to stay in camps which was not as pleasant, while those with bad characters were staying in Chinese hotels. It was then decided by the Committee of the Kitchen Fund to find some premises and house these people.

Eventually premises at 349/41, Chusan Rd., was rented from the Shanghai Land Investment Co., by the S.A.C.R.A. for this purpose at a rental of $40 per month and preparations were made to accomodate about 30 persons.

(a) Regarding the premises itself, thefollowing information was supplied to the undersigned who personally visited the house
The house is an old Chinese type dwelling-house consisting of a ground, first and second floor. Each floor is accomdated with 10 cheap iron bedsteads, mattress and one bedsheet . On the roof garden of thepremises there is a Chinese type W.C. On the ground floor there is a water-tap with which refugees take their daily baths. There is no accomodation for a kitchen and no cooking is done on the premises. Bread is sent to the house once a day for each of the refugees and one hot meal a day is supplied to each person at the Seward Road camp.

(b) Inmates:-
At present there are 22 inmates in the house and all have previous convictions, except three, who although not previously convicted, have bad characters. The following are the names of those residing in the house:-

主题：重新开放舟山路难民（犹太）营地。

自五个犹太难民营开放以来，凡有监狱记录或已知品行不端者，均不准居住在任何一处营地中。作出此决定的原因是，品行清白的难民不愿与有监狱记录者混居，因此厨房基金委员会决定为先前定罪的难民寻找某种住所。去年有一段时间，这些人被安置在救世军的房舍内，厨房基金需按每人每天1美元的标准支付费用。当几个月前救世军不再提供住宿时，厨房基金在如何安置这些人方面感到束手无策。由于未找到其他出路，厨房基金委员会以每人12或15美元的价格，将这些人在虹口的三等华资旅馆安置。这对委员会来说过于昂贵，而且许多住在营地里的品行良好的难民也反对这一事实：他们没有刑期却不得不待在不如中国旅馆舒适的营地里，而那些品行不良者却住在中国旅馆里。于是，厨房基金委员会决定寻找一些房舍来安置这些人。

最终，上海阿什肯纳兹协作救济协会（S.A.C.R.A.）为此目的从上海地产投资公司租下了舟山路349/41号的房舍，租金为每月40美元，并做了容纳约30人的准备。

(a) 关于房舍本身，下列信息已提供给签署人，签署人曾亲自视察该房屋：
该房屋是一栋老式中式住宅，包括底层、一楼和二楼。每层楼配有10张廉价铁床架、床垫和一条床单。房舍的屋顶花园上有一个中式厕所。底层有一个水龙头，难民在此进行日常沐浴。房内没有厨房设施，也不在房内做饭。每天向该房屋运送一次面包供每位难民食用，每人每天的一顿热餐则在西华德路营地供应。

(b) 住户：-
目前屋内有22名住户，除三人外均有前科，这三人虽无前科，但品行不良。居住在屋内的人员名单如下：-

All inmates have to abide by the Camp Rules which are as follows:-
1. The orders given by the man on duty of the Labour Service have to be followed strictly.
2. Every Person living in the camp has to be at home latest at 11 p.m. and is not allowed to leave the camp before 8 a.m.
3. Persons who have not been in the camp for 2 nights have no right whatsoever for sheltering from the Kitchen Fund. Furthermore the Kitchen Fund is entitled to withdraw bread and meal tickets
4. Cleanliness has strictly to be observed in all rooms. Everyone is obliged to take part on the cleaning according to a certain scheme.
5. Smoking, when laying in the beds, is prohibited.
6. Every inmate on his admission receives 1 blanket and 1 sheet and is responsible for these things. No substitute will be given in case of loss.

Upon instructions received from D.S.I. Koyama, the under-
signed visited the above-mentioned premises at 11 a.m. on 19-7-43
and obtained the following information:-

The house in question is an old Chinese-type dwelling
house consisting of a ground, first and second floor. There is no
furniture in the house except for about 25 iron beds. There is an
old-fashioned Chinese type W.C. situated on the roof garden of
the house and a water-tap on the ground floor. There is no kitchen
on the premises and inmates have to proceed to 961, E. Seward Road,
(Kitchen Fund's dining room) for their meals. Bread is sent to the
house once a day for the inmates.

At present there are only 22 inmates residing on the prem-
ises but 10 more are expected in the near future. All inmates have
received convictions at least twice and it is the idea of the
committee of the Kitchen Fund to separate these persons from those
who have not received convictions.

The premises were obtained by the S.A.C.R.A. for the Kitchen
Fund. The house was rented from a German Refugee, Mr. Hugo Alexander
who is the sub-tenant of the house, for $40 a month's rental.
Mr. Julius Eick is in charge of the camp and he in turn has put a

主题：再次申请“厨房基金--管理委员会”运营舟山路349/41号（界内区域）的房屋。
用于安置有定罪记录的德国难民。

根据小山分区督察收到的指示，签署人于1943年7月19日上午11时视察了上述房舍，并获得以下信息：-

该房屋是一栋老式中式住宅，包括底层、一楼和二楼。屋内除约25张铁床外，没有其他家具。屋后屋顶花园上有一个老式中式的厕所，底层有一个水龙头。 premises 内没有厨房，住户必须前往东西华德路961号（厨房基金的餐厅）用餐。每天向屋内运送一次面包供住户食用。

目前仅有22名住户居住在该处，但预计近期还将增加10人。所有住户至少被判刑两次，厨房基金委员会的想法是将这些人与未受过定罪的人分开。

该房舍由上海阿什肯纳兹协作救济协会（S.A.C.R.A.）为厨房基金取得。房屋是从一名德国难民 Hugo Alexander 先生处租来的，他是该房屋的转租人，月租金为40美元。Julius Eick 先生负责营地管理，他随即指派了一名32岁的德国难民 Harry Frank 先生担任常驻监督员。~~Mr.~~
~~Frank is not a convicted person.~~ （此处原文有删除线，意为：Frank 先生并非有定罪记录之人。）

主管警官 Morris Gantvoort
副警务总监

REPORT

239
Station: Foreign Affairs File No. Date: July 21st, 1943.
26/7

SUBJECT: Report on S.A.C.R.A. Meeting of Supporters
at the Shanghai Jewish Club on the 20-7-43.

I. Name of organization:- "S.A.C.R.A." (Shanghai Ashke-
nazi Corroborating Relief Asso-
ciation).

2. Office address:- 137 Peking Road. Tel. No. 16279.

3. Kind of Meeting:- Meeting called by the SACRA orga-
nization of members of the Sh. Ash-
kenazi Jewish Communal Association.

4. Time & date:- Between 9.45 p.m. and 10.15 p.m.
on the 20-th of July, 1943.

5. Place:- Shanghai Jewish Club, 1623 Avenue
Road, Tel. 34205.

（批：SACRA / 找王邦文报告提）

6. Chairman & Secretary: Dr. A.J. Cohn- chairman. S. Li-
berman - secretary.

7. Attendance:- About 200 persons.

8. Main points of dis-
cussions, etc.:- THE MEETING WAS WITHOUT DISCUSSION .

1. Report on activities of the SACRA.

2. Regarding the Charity Section of the
SACRA.

3. Co-optation of six persons for collo-
boration in the Charity Section.

CONTENT.

I. Dr. A.J. Cohn opened the meeting, thanking first of
all Mr. Kubota and Mr. Kano for the attendance and also for
the attendance on the 13-th of July, when the meeting did
not take place owing to heavy rain and of non-attendance of
the supporters. He further stated that the meeting has been
called to call the attention of the assembled persons to
the fact that the SACRA organization with the full coopera-
tion of Mr. Kubota and Mr. Kano, since the issue of the
Proclamation on the 18-th of February (5 months) has from
15,000 to 17,000 persons made comfortable in their present
lodgings, but that many of these persons have to be assi-
sted with clothing and footwear. That from the beginning
of the SACRA it has been the idea to organize a Charity
Section, which should take care of those matter, but that
the SACRA had been very busy with the housing problem and
therefore it is now time for the organization of the Charit
Section, asking to support this movement and elect 6 per-
sons, who should cooperate with the 6 persons from the
SACRA and so form the Charity Section. That the SACRA has
appointed A. Oppenheim as the Chairman of the Section and
all assembled must support this new section, same as they
supported the building section, and must assist in building
the "Constructive Help" for the refugees.

（印：INDEXED IN (S.E.) REGISTRY DATE 26/7/43）

分局：外事科 档案号： 日期：1943年7月21日。
26/7

主题：关于1943年7月20日在上海犹太俱乐部举行的S.A.C.R.A.支持者会议的报告。

I. 组织名称：“S.A.C.R.A.”（上海阿什肯纳兹犹太人救济协会，Shanghai Ashkenazi Corroborating Relief Association）。

2. 办公地址：北京路137号。电话：16279。

3. 会议性质：由上海阿什肯纳兹犹太人社区协会成员组成的SACRA组织召开的会议。

4. 时间与日期：1943年7月20日晚9时45分至10时15分之间。

5. 地点：上海犹太俱乐部，爱文义路1623号，电话：34205。

（批：SACRA / 找王邦文报告提）

6. 主席及秘书：A.J. Cohn博士——主席。S. Liberman——秘书。

7. 出席人数：约200人。

8. 讨论要点等：会议未进行讨论。

1. 关于SACRA活动的报告。

2. 关于SACRA慈善部门的事宜。

3. 增选六人参与慈善部门的协作工作。

内容。

I. A.J. Cohn博士宣布开会，首先感谢久保田先生和加能先生的出席，同时也感谢他们出席了7月13日的会议，当时因大雨及支持者缺席导致会议未能举行。他进一步指出，召开此次会议是为了提请与会者注意这一事实：自2月18日发布公告（历时5个月）以来，在久保田先生和加能先生的全力合作下，SACRA组织已使15,000至17,000人在其现有住所中安顿下来，但其中许多人仍需衣物和鞋履方面的援助。自SACRA成立之初，其构想便是设立一个慈善部门来负责此类事务，但SACRA一直忙于解决住房问题，因此现在是组建慈善部门的时候了，请求支持这一举措并选举6人，与来自SACRA的6人共同合作，从而组成慈善部门。SACRA已任命A. Oppenheim为该部门主席，所有与会者必须像支持建房部门那样支持这个新部门，并协助为难民构建“建设性援助”。

（印：索引入（东南区）登记处 日期 1943年7月26日）
