2.

Statistical Foreign Affairs.................... File No.................... Date July 21-st. 1943.

SUBJECT: (cont).

Dr. Cohn then introduced Mr. Kubota as the Director for the Jewish Affairs and Mr. Kubota addressed the assembled persons as follows:- (Translated by Dr. Cohn).

Since the 18-th of February, date of the issue of the Proclamation, restricting the stateless refugees the SACRA has moved from 15,000 to 17,000 persons into the designated area, which is about 80% of all stateless refugees in Shanghai, and can be considered a very good achievement. On the last occasion Mr. Kubota continued, I already stated that the Proclamation is not an anti-semitic move and the SACRA has been given full assistance in their work.
When the SACRA was founded there were two main points
1/ To cooperate with the Japanese authorities.
2/ To assist in the organization of the refugees in the designated area, because the Japanese authorities have no time to do so.
I have known the members of SACRA and wish to express thanks for their work. Now we are again asking help from the SACRA.
There can be observed three classes of refugees:
1/ Persons who work and support themselves.
2/ Persons who work, but cannot support themselves.
3/ Persons who work and can also support others.
The last category of persons is the best, because they can help others.
There are still persons :
1/ Who are lazy and do not want to work.
2/ There are the persons who work only for themselves.
None of you are here of the two categories and you have come to help others. You must cooperate with the SACRA and the Japanese authorities also assist the SACRA. I must tell you that only 5 months have passed , but that it may be possible that the help will be required for a considerable time. I ask you to study this problem carefully and wish you good success in your work.
NOTE: The speech of Mr. Kubota was enthusiastically received by the assembled persons.

2. A. Oppenheim spoke about the organization of the Charity Section, stating that the SACRA had been very busy in dealing with about over 15,000 persons who came to the office for various reasons during the last 5 months. That thanks must be expressed to Mr. Kubota and Mr. Kano for their kind assistance in the great work and also to Dr. Cohn as the chairman of the SACRA, but this was not all and all Jews in Shanghai must help in the matter, because there are many persons, old and sick, who cannot work and therefore cannot support themselves. The Kitchen Fund is supporting over 4000 persons with one loaf of bread (9ozs) and one hot meal. In the present condition the sum for this support cannot be raised, therefore the Shanghai Jews must help. This must be done before any constructive help can be

（左侧竖排批注：譯語ノ意味ヲ正確ニ把握シ得ザリシカト邦文報告書參照）

报告
2.

统计 外事科.................... 档案号.................... 日期 1943年7月21日。

主题：（续）。

随后，Cohn博士介绍久保田先生为犹太事务主管，久保田先生向与会者发表讲话如下：（由Cohn博士翻译）。

自2月18日发布限制无国籍难民的公告之日起，SACRA已将15,000至17,000人迁入指定区域，这约占上海所有无国籍难民的80%，可被视为一项非常良好的成就。久保田先生接着说，在上次场合我已声明，该公告并非反犹举措，且SACRA在其工作中已获得充分协助。
SACRA成立时有两个主要要点：
1/ 与日本当局合作。
2/ 协助组织指定区域内的难民，因为日本当局无暇顾及此事。
我认识SACRA的成员，并对他们的工作表示感谢。现在我们再次请求SACRA提供帮助。
可以观察到难民分为三类：
1/ 有工作并能自食其力的人。
2/ 有工作但无法自食其力的人。
3/ 有工作且能供养他人的人。
最后一类人最好，因为他们能帮助他人。
仍存在以下人员：
1/ 懒惰且不愿工作的人。
2/ 只为自己工作的人。
在座的各位不属于这两类，你们是来帮助他人的。你们必须与SACRA合作，日本当局也会协助SACRA。我必须告诉你们，虽然仅过去了5个月，但这种援助可能需要持续相当长的一段时间。我请你们仔细研究这个问题，并祝愿你们工作顺利。
注：久保田先生的演讲受到与会者的热烈欢迎。

2. A. Oppenheim就慈善部门的组建发表讲话，指出SACRA在过去5个月里忙于处理因各种原因来到办公室的超过15,000人的事务。他表示必须感谢久保田先生和加能先生在这项伟大工作中给予的亲切协助，同时也感谢SACRA主席Cohn博士，但这还不够，上海的所有犹太人都必须在此事上提供帮助，因为有许多年老和患病的人无法工作，因此无法维持生计。厨房基金正以一条面包（9盎司）和一顿热饭供养着4000多人。在目前的情况下，无法筹集到足够的资金来维持这种供养，因此上海的犹太人必须提供帮助。在任何建设性援助能够

（左侧竖排批注：是否未能准确把握译语含义，请参阅日文报告书）

5.

Station Foreign Affairs File No. Date July 21-st, 1943.

SUBJECT: (cont).
arranged. The Kitchen Fund requires $ 800,000.00 every month, but can raise only the sum of about $ 500,000.00 therefore the remaining $ 300,000.00 must be collected every month for the support of the destitute refugees. The Medical care for the destitute refugees is rather small and comes to $ 50,000.00 per month.

The next speaker was G.Shifrin, from the Finance Committee of the SACRA, who stated that it is the first time that the SACRA raises the question of the Charity Section, because the SACRA was engaged with other problems. He pointed out that the contributions of the Ashkenazi Jews was in July only $ 5,000.00, collected through the "Centrjewcom", whilst the expenses of the Kitchen Fund are about $ 800,000.00 per month. That the bread supply alone costs $ 520,000.00 for 4700 destitute persons and each hot meal costs $ 3.00. The "Eastjewcom" and the "Centrjewcom" must be dissolved because they cannot exist any longer.
We know that the Japanese authorities are able to support the refugees, but we must help our own brethren in need and the Jews of the whole world are spending for charity. The sum of $300,000.00 per month is not so large. We are calling to the good heart of the Jews for support. There is one instance in our Thora when Jews were called to contribute money in order to build a temple and in two days so much money was collected that some of it was returned to the donors. After the war the Jews of Shanghai will be asked what did they do for their brethren in misfortune and they will be sorry to say that they did not do enough for their own people. If we want to rob we go into a dark corner, therefore do a good thing and be in the light.
5. He then stated that 6 persons must be elected for the new Charity Section and read out the following names as candidates, who will work together with 6 members of the SACRA organization.
1. U. Gertsenstein.
2. E. Touchinsky.
3. J. Wallach.
4. Y. Zolovich.
5. N. Klebanoff.
6. V. Kaffel.
The above 6 candidates were unanimously approved.
The 6 members from the SACRA are as follows.
1. A. Oppenheim, chairman.
2. S. Liberman , Secretary.
3. G. Shifrin.
4. S. Tukachinsky.
5. F. Nemchenko.
6. J. Bitker.
Dr. Cohn then thanked the assembled persons and closed the meeting at 10.15 p.m.

COMMENT.
The meeting as already stated was without any discussions, because the propositions of the SACRA must be accepted without comment, although it could be seen that many did not agree with the propositions and wanted to question the members of the SACRA about the expenditure of the money collected for the building and repairi

5.

分局 外事科 档案号： 日期 1943年7月21日。

安排之前完成此事。厨房基金每月需要800,000.00美元，但只能筹集到约500,000.00美元，因此每月必须筹集剩余的300,000.00美元以支持贫困难民。贫困难民的医疗护理规模较小，每月费用为50,000.00美元。

下一位发言者是SACRA财务委员会的G. Shifrin，他指出，这是SACRA首次提出慈善部门的问题，因为SACRA此前一直忙于其他问题。他指出，阿什肯纳兹犹太人在7月份通过“Centrjewcom”（中央犹太委员会）仅筹集了5,000.00美元，而厨房基金的支出约为每月800,000.00美元。仅面包供应一项，4700名贫困人员的费用就高达520,000.00美元，每顿热饭的费用为3.00美元。“Eastjewcom”（东方犹太委员会）和“Centrjewcom”（中央犹太委员会）必须解散，因为它们已无法继续存在。
我们知道日本当局有能力供养难民，但我们必须帮助我们需要帮助的同胞，全世界的犹太人都在为慈善事业捐款。每月300,000.00美元的数额并不算大。我们呼吁犹太人凭良心提供支持。我们的《托拉》中有一个例子，当时号召犹太人捐款建造圣殿，两天内筹集的资金之多，以至于部分款项不得不退还给捐赠者。战后，上海的犹太人将被问及他们为处于不幸中的同胞做了什么，如果他们说自己为本族人做得不够，将会感到遗憾。如果我们想抢劫，我们会躲进黑暗的角落，因此要做善事，站在光明之中。
5. 他随后指出，必须为新成立的慈善部门选举6人，并宣读了以下候选人名单，他们将同SACRA组织的6名成员一起工作。
1. U. Gertsenstein。
2. E. Touchinsky。
3. J. Wallach。
4. Y. Zolovich。
5. N. Klebanoff。
6. V. Kaffel。
上述6名候选人一致获得批准。
来自SACRA的6名成员如下：
1. A. Oppenheim，主席。
2. S. Liberman，秘书。
3. G. Shifrin。
4. S. Tukachinsky。
5. F. Nemchenko。
6. J. Bitker。
Cohn博士随后感谢与会者，并于晚10时15分宣布散会。

评论。
如前所述，会议未进行任何讨论，因为SACRA的提议必须无条件接受，尽管可以看出许多人不同意这些提议，并希望就SACRA成员为SACRA为难民获取的建筑和房屋所进行的修建工作以及为此从俄罗斯犹太人那里筹集的约2,500,000.00美元（其中仅有5%未存入SACRA现金箱）的资金支出情况向SACRA成员提出质询。

the buildings and houses obtained by the SACRA for the
Stateless Refugees and for which work the SACRA did col-
lect from the Russian Jews about $ 2,500,000.00 of which
only 5% has not been paid into the SACRA cash box.

It is quiet obvious that all concerned, including
the members of the SACRA, do not agree to spending money
for the refugees, but are forced by circumstances to do
so and are not in a position to object openly to the
proposals made at the meeting.

Although already twice stated by Mr. Kubota that the
Proclamation is not an anti-semitic measure, none of the
Jews believe this statement and believe that the restric-
tions against the Jews have been made through the influ-
ence of the Nanking Government.

Eggarson

Crime & Special Branches.

SUBJECT: Confirmation of "Extentions" by the Shanghai Stateless Refugee Affairs Bureau

Shortly before May 18th, 1943, extentions were issued by the S.A.C.R.A. to such refugees who for professional or other reasons has asked for permission to remain for same time outside the designated area. The extentions were given from 1 to 6 months.

On July 11th, 13th, and 14th, the Stateless Refugee Affairs Bureau called up the holders of 285 extentions in order to confirm them. (The total of extensions issued was 524). These extentions do not only refer to individuals but also to families. Taking an average of 2-3 persons per extention certificate, about 700 persons are still residing outsid the designated with extentions. The majority of them will expire at the end of August 1943.

For those refugees, who did not get their extentions confirmed and who consequently are no longer entitled to reside outside the designated area, The S.A.C.R.A., in its Notification No. 33 of July 16th, offered provisional shelter in Godown No. 3 at 630 Muirhead Rd, as far as they could not make their own arrangements.

It is learnt from the S.A.C.R.A that 114 persons have asked for shelter in the above Godown. They have been given a final limit until August 5th, by which date they will have to remove to 630 Muirhead Rd.

Sullivan
o i/c Foreign Affairs Section
C & S Branch

主题：确认上海无国籍难民事务局签发的“延期许可”

1943年5月18日前不久，S.A.C.R.A.向那些因职业或其他原因申请获准在指定区域外暂时停留的难民签发了延期许可。延期期限为1至6个月。

7月11日、13日和14日，无国籍难民事务局传召了285名持有延期许可的人员以确认其效力。（签发的延期许可总数为524份）。这些延期许可不仅涉及个人，也涉及家庭。按每份延期许可证平均2-3人计算，约有700人仍凭延期许可居住在指定区域外。其中大多数人的许可将于1943年8月底到期。

对于那些未获得延期许可确认、因而不再有权居住在指定区域外的难民，S.A.C.R.A.在其7月16日的第33号通知中表示，只要他们无法自行安排，将在穆黑德路630号的3号仓库提供临时住所。

据S.A.C.R.A.获悉，有114人申请在上述仓库住宿。已给予他们最后期限至8月5日，届时他们必须搬至穆黑德路630号。

Sullivan

SUBJECT: Re Intended Meeting of Russian Jews, called by the S.A.J.R.A. Organization

With reference to the meeting of the Ashkenazi Association Jews called by the S.A.J.R.A. organization for 8 p.m. on the 13-th of July, 1943, at the Shanghai Jewish Club, 1023 Avenue Road, the undersigned begs to state that the meeting did not take place, owing to the very small number of persons appearing at the meeting.

This unattendance of the Jews can be attributed first of all to the fact that the meetings called by the S.A.J.R.A. are always connected with money contributions and it is known that at the present time the SAJRA is short of money for the repairs of houses on Ward Road near Hashing Road and secondly owing to the heavy rain on the evening of the 13-th.

At 8 p.m. there were about 15 persons of the most prominent Russian Jews and members of the SAJRA, who were very confused about the non-attendance at the meeting moreover so because Mr. Kubota and Mr. Kano from the Stateless Refugee Bureau had arrived and Mr. Kubota intended to address the meeting. An attempt was made to close the card and billiard games in order that the persons engaged by the games should attend the meeting, however after counting all the people in the club, the total came only less than 50, whilst the expected number was between 250 to 300 persons to attend the meeting. Such state of affairs was considered unsatisfactory for requesting Mr. Kubota to address and the meeting was postponed to an undefinite date. Remarks could be heard "No person wishes to part with his money". The undersigned left at 9.30 p.m., after Mr. Kubota and Mr. Kano had departed.

主题：关于 S.A.J.R.A. 组织召集的俄罗斯犹太人拟议会议

关于 S.A.J.R.A. 组织于 1943 年 7 月 13 日晚上 8 点在爱文义路 1023 号上海犹太俱乐部召集的阿什肯纳兹犹太人协会会议，谨此报告，由于出席会议的人数极少，该会议并未举行。

犹太人缺席的原因，首先是因为 S.A.J.R.A. 召集的会议总是与捐款有关，而众所周知，目前 S.A.J.R.A. 缺乏资金用于维修华德路靠近哈兴路（Hashing Road）（音译）附近的房屋；其次是因为 13 日晚的大雨。

晚上 8 点时，约有 15 位最显赫的俄罗斯犹太人和 S.A.J.R.A. 成员在场，他们对无人出席会议感到非常困惑，尤其是因为无国籍难民局的久保田先生（Mr. Kubota）和加诺先生（Mr. Kano）已经抵达，且久保田先生打算在会议上发表讲话。曾试图停止牌类和台球游戏，以便让参与游戏的人参加会议，然而，在清点俱乐部内的所有人后，总数不到 50 人，而预期出席会议的人数在 250 至 300 人之间。鉴于这种情况，认为请久保田先生讲话并不合适，会议被无限期推迟。现场可听到这样的议论：“没有人愿意掏钱”。在久保田先生和加诺先生离开后，本人于晚上 9 点 30 分离开。

SUBJECT: Stateless Refugees - Removal to the Designated Area.

In connection with the removal of the Stateless Refugees into the Designated Area it can be stated that the majority, about 90%, have now removed into the area or together with the persons who were already residents of the area, there are at present not less than 13,600 stateless refugees, of whom about 6,600 moved into the area and about 7,000 lived inside the area.

About 250 refugees received prolongation, mostly consisting of doctors, lawyers and religious persons. Most of them have to move in by the 1-st of June.
About 1400 refugees received prolongation, because of special circumstances, they were unable to accomplish the removal owing to some unforeseen reason without loss of property.

Change of houses:- About 415 cases of change of houses have been registered. Accomplished in 145 cases.
251 houses were changed with Japanese subjects and this consists 60% of all changes. Accomplished in 80 cases.
110 houses were changed with Chinese citizens. Accomplished in 36 cases.
54 houses with various foreigners. Accomplished in 29 cases.

The stateless refugees have now to apply for Special Passes to leave the Designated Area, to the Stateless Refugee Affairs Office. The following particulars are required for the application;

a/ Applications to be made between the 20-th and 30-th of May, 1943.
b/ Name and address of employment.
c/ Route by which the applicant wishes to proceed from his home in the area to place of employment.
d/ Time required for the employment - daily.
e/ Applicant is responsible for the correctness of the information furnished on the application.
f/ Must have a guarantor or the signature of the employer, who shall be responsible for the action of the applicant.

主题：无国籍难民 - 迁往指定区域。

关于无国籍难民迁往指定区域一事，可以说大多数人，约 90%，现已迁入该区域；或者加上原本就是该区域居民的人，目前至少有 13,600 名无国籍难民，其中约 6,600 人迁入该区域，约 7,000 人原本就居住在该区域内。

约 250 名难民获得延期，主要由医生、律师和宗教人士组成。他们中的大多数人必须在 6 月 1 日前迁入。
约 1400 名难民因特殊情况获得延期，由于某些不可预见的原因，若不造成财产损失，他们无法完成搬迁。

与日本臣民交换房屋 251 起，占所有换房案例的 60%。已完成 80 起。
与中国公民交换房屋 110 起。已完成 36 起。
与其他外国人交换房屋 54 起。已完成 29 起。

It must be stated that a number of refugees were not

premises on East Tihang Road as set down by the S.J.M.

cluding electricity and water, etc.

However at present 80% of the 114 rooms in the above
mentioned place have already been taken by stateless re-
fugees, who could not find suitable houses or rooms else
where in the designated area.

The Polish Jewish Refugees, supported by the "Eastjeru-

refugees are not satisfied with the premises, owing to
the cement floor, and recently went to the SACRA, 137

accommodated in private houses in the designated area.

SUBJECT: Problems of the Stateless Refugees.

Consternation is prevailing amongst
the Stateless refugees, since the 18th of May is now
so very near and the situation in every respect has be-
come far worse for them and is still daily growing more
serious. From the numerous problems confronting them,
the most important are the ones connected with their
work and with their housing.

As to the first of the two problems,
the Refugees clearly realize that in the long run it will
be the more serious one because there are very few people
who are in a position to cover their daily expenses for
an uncertain period without earning money. And whether
they will be able to earn money is -- at least in their
eyes -- very questionable. Owing to the very deplorable
fact, that until to-day, that is 11 days before the Mili-
tary Proclamation is to become effective, not one clear
regulation has been issued by the authorities, the people
not only suffer financial losses and inconvenience, but
what is more important, they still dont know what will
happen to their business and whether they will be able
to continue their work. According to the rumour circulating
amongst the Refugees the Doctors, Pharmacies, and some
people, who have friends in the SACRA will be exempted,
but this will be not more than about 500 people, the rest
of about 16.000 refugees, so continue the rumours will
after two or three months be locked up in the designated
area and will be unable to obtain permits to continue
their work. Now the average amount of money, which a

主题：无国籍难民的问题。

自5月18日日益临近以来，无国籍难民中普遍存在恐慌情绪，他们的处境在各方面都变得更加糟糕，并且每天都在变得更加严峻。在他们面临的众多问题中，最重要的是与工作和住房有关的问题。

关于这两个问题中的第一个，难民们清楚地认识到，从长远来看，这将是一个更为严重的问题，因为很少有人能够在没有收入的情况下，在不确定的时期内维持日常开支。而他们是否能够赚钱——至少在他们看来——是非常值得怀疑的。由于一个非常令人遗憾的事实，即直到今天，也就是军事公告生效前11天，当局尚未发布任何明确的规定，人们不仅遭受经济损失和不便，而且更重要的是，他们仍然不知道自己的生意会发生什么变化，以及是否能够继续工作。根据在难民中流传的谣言，医生、药店以及一些在协援会（SACRA）中有朋友的人将被豁免，但这将不超过约500人，其余约16,000名难民，据谣言称，将在两三个月后被关进指定区域，并将无法获得继续工作的许可。现在，平均每个

the S.A.C.R.A. for the conversion of the above school
building.
All contracts for the exchange of houses, flats,
etc.have to be registered with the S.A.C.R.A.
The following additional members have been add-
ed to the Executive Committee:M.Regovin, M.Oppenheim,
J.Bitker, G.Klebsnoff.
On the initiative of The Hon.President,Dr.Cohn,
a health and sanitation department has been formed,
which will be assisted by all doctors of the Jewish
hospital. An identical committee will be organized
by the J.A.C.
Compulsory Contributions for the increase
of S.A.C.R.A.Funds
In order to raise the necessary funds, the
local Jewish population will have to make compulso-
ry contributions.A scale has already been worked out
for the taxation of the Ashkenazi Jewish Community
Taxation of other Jewish communities will follow.
Ashkenazi Jews have already been circularized to
this effect. The lowest contribution has been fixed
at $ 300.- The Finance Committee of the S.A.C.R.A.
stresses that the activity of the S.A.C.R.A. is not
based on charity. It is intended to reorganize the
the S.A.C.R.A. lateron into a great economic syndi-
cate and therefore contributions are not to be consi-
dered as donations but as investment in the S.A.C.
R.A. funds which will most likely be refunded with
interests.
The Application Section informs that registra-
tions, as well as applications for permits and exemp-
tion are being considered at present and that they
will be passed on for approval.Persons who receive
permits, will be given special certificates.

协援会住房委员会在行动
239
1943年4月12日
当局已批准住房委员会使用同山路的大型校舍建筑。将其改建为5处住所的工作已在进行中。137个房间将在4周内准备就绪，可容纳500-550人。关于救世军（Salvation Army）房产的谈判即将结束。住房委员会还在就指定区域内的空闲工厂和仓库进行谈判。从本月8日起，住房委员会将积极支持房屋和住所的交换。每个人应先与其交换伙伴协商，达成协议后向协援会住房科申请。
协援会已拨款 500,000 美元用于上述校舍建筑的改建。
所有房屋、公寓等的交换合同必须在协援会登记。
执行委员会增加了以下新成员：M.Regovin, M.Oppenheim, J.Bitker, G.Klebsnoff。
在荣誉主席科恩博士（Dr. Cohn）的倡议下，成立了一个卫生部门，将由犹太医院的所有医生协助。犹太援助委员会（J.A.C.）也将组织一个相同的委员会。
增加协援会资金的强制捐款
为了筹集必要资金，当地犹太人口必须进行强制捐款。阿什肯纳兹犹太社区的征税标准已经制定出来。其他犹太社区的征税将随后进行。阿什肯纳兹犹太人已经收到以此为目的的通知。最低捐款额定为 300 美元。协援会财务委员会强调，协援会的活动并非基于慈善。其目的是日后将协援会重组为一个大型经济辛迪加，因此捐款不应被视为捐赠，而应视为对协援会基金的投资，这些投资很可能会连同利息一起退还。
申请科告知，目前的登记以及许可证和豁免申请正在审议中，并将提交批准。获得许可证的人员将获得特别证书。

Reorganization of the Jewish Gemeinde
239
2-4-43
The S.A.C.R.A. has received an order according
to which it is to reorganize the Governing Board
and the Board of Representatives of the Jewish
Gemeinde. The two boards had been dissolved by
order of the Office for the Shanghai Stateless
Refugee Affairs, because their work in connection
with the Proclamation had not been satisfactory.
Mr. L.M. Rogovin, member of the S.A.C.R.A. was
appointed supervisor of the Gemeinde. The follow-
ing 5 men were charged with the continuation of the
Gemeinde's affairs. George Abraham, R.R.Glaser,
Ernst Mondschein, Egon Starer, Fritz J.Wolff will
have to reorganize the Jewish Gemeinde so that it
can become the head organization for the whole
emigrant community. The public will be kept in-
formed about the progress of this work.Monthly
accounts will also be published.
Through reorganization the Jewish Gemeinde is
to prepare the way for self-administration with-
in the emigrant community.

通过重组，犹太公会将为移民社区内的自我管理铺平道路。

SUBJECT: Affiliation of the Jewish Gemeinde to the

At a meeting held at 5 p.m. on April 5th, 1943
at the Jewish Club, 1623 Avenue Rd, Dr. A.J. Cohn, Hon.
Chairman of the S.A.C.R.A., declared before representati-
ves of the S.A.C.R.A., the Jewish Gemeinde and the Kit-
chen Fund that with immediate effect the Jewish Gemeinde
is affiliated to the S.A.C.R.A. and thereby to the
Office for the Shanghai Stateless Refugee Affairs.
The Governing Board and the Board of representatives
are dismissed and the following persons will act as
executives for the affairs of the Jewish Gemeinde:
Head: L.M. Rogovin, Russian Emigrant, chairman of the
Centrajewcom
Executives: R.R. Glaser, stateless Jew, 340/85 Route
Cohen
Fr. J. Wolff, -do- 81 Rue Maresca

E. Mondschein -do- 565 E. Seward Rd
G.G. Abraham -do- 4 Gordon Rd

Glaser and Wolff are members of the Kitchen -
Fund, Starer and Mondschein are on the committee of the

for the Kitchen Fund.

moned the members of the Governing Board and the Board
of Representatives to the Jewish Gemeinde premises

Station........................................ File No.................... Date....................

SUBJECT:
        Comment

    Although the Jewish Gemeinde had been much
critisized for some time, the above desribed changes
came as a big surprise to the majority of refugees
in general and the members of the Jewish Gemeinde in
particular. It can not be said that the old Governing
Board of the Gemeinde enjoyed the confidence of the
wide masses and this may also be taken as a reason
why the membership of the Gemeinde has constantly de-
creased. The objections against the old Governing Board
were not so much of a personal character as against
the way in which the Gemeinde's affairs were managed.
Furthermore new elections of the Governing Board and
the Board of Representatives have been due and the
Gemeinde was charged with intentionally delaying them.
Another argument was that paid employees ██████████
of the Gemeinde were members of the Board of Representa-
tives. By being employees of the Gemeinde they could
not be expected to judge independantly in all matters.
The new executives are financially well off and there-
fore are to be expected to form themselves independant
opinions on all matters. One of the new executives
attacked the Gemeinde openly in the columns of the
Shanghai Jewish Chronicle on account of the Gemeinde's
Budget.
    It remains to be seen whether or not the Autho-
rities intend the Jewish Gemeinde to continue to exist
as a separate organization. It is quite possible that
a centralization of all Refugee money raising institu-
tions is intended and that this was the first step.

                                        (签名)
O i/c Foreign Affairs Section
C & S Branch

警署........................................ 档案号.................... 日期....................

主题：
        评论

    尽管犹太公会（Jewish Gemeinde）长期以来备受批评，但上述变化仍令广大难民普遍感到意外，尤其是令犹太公会的成员深感震惊。不能说公会的旧理事会享有广大民众的信任，这也可被视为公会会员人数持续减少的一个原因。对旧理事会的反对意见，与其说是针对个人，不如说是针对公会事务的管理方式。此外，理事会和代表委员会的新选举早已到期，而公会被指责故意拖延选举。另一个反对理由是，公会的受薪雇员 ██████████ 是代表委员会的成员。作为公会的雇员，人们不能指望他们在所有事务上都能独立作出判断。新任执行委员经济宽裕，因此有望在所有事务上形成独立的意见。其中一名新任执行委员曾在《上海犹太纪事报》（Shanghai Jewish Chronicle）的专栏中，因公会预算问题公开抨击公会。
    当局是否打算让犹太公会作为一个独立组织继续存在，尚待观察。完全有可能当局意图将所有难民筹款机构集中统一管理，而此举正是第一步。

                                        (签名)
外事科主管
刑事与特别科

3月5日
供无国籍难民知晓
--- 谨告知无国籍难民，在久保田先生（Mr. Kubota）的指导下，上海阿什肯纳兹犹太社区协会（Shanghai Ashkenazi Jewish Communal Association）已选举产生一个代表团体，并于2月28日组建了一个委员会，名为 S.A.C.R.A.（上海阿什肯纳兹合作救济协会，Shanghai Ashkenazi Collaborating Relief Association）。SACRA 将与“上海无国籍难民事务办公室”密切合作，监督对受影响人员的救济工作并提供一切协助。此外，宣布成立一个联合委员会，由 SACRA 成员、厨房基金（Kitchen Fund）、犹太公会以及受影响的波兰移民的代表组成。该联合委员会名为 J.A.C.（联合行政委员会，Joint Administrative Committee），将负责实际的行政工作，并已设立以下部门：住房、许可证、经济问题、法律部、新闻处。其他处理营养、就业、卫生、医院、运输等事务的部门也将很快成立。
除波兰代表外，J.A.C. 还包括由犹太公会和厨房基金委派的以下人员：伯格格拉斯博士（Dr. Bergglas，主席）、F. 卡尔德格博士（Dr. F. Kardegg，副主席）、西伯斯坦博士（Dr. Siberstein，司库）、H. 赖纳（H. Reiner，名誉秘书）、奥西·莱文（Ossi Lewin）、卢茨·瓦克斯纳（Lutz Wachsner）、海尼·帕恩斯（Heini Parnes）、普尔弗马赫（Pulvermacher）。

The two above mentioned bodies have formed the J.A.C.
into which the stateless refugees have delegated the
following persons:
Provisional presiding committee: Dr.Bergglas-chairman,
Dr.Kardegg-Vice Chairman, Dr.Silberstein-Hon.XXXXXXX,
Treasurer, H.Heiner- Hon.Secretary.

Economic: Reiner and Paines
Juridical: Dr.Kardegg
Press: Ossi Lewin

17-3
Information of the S.A.C.R.A.
All stateless refugees, affected by the Proclamation of
Febr.18th, have to register on forms provided by the
S.A.C.R.A. Exempted are juveniles of 16 and under.
Persons residing In The Settlement south of the Hongkew
Creek, French Concession and Western Area register at
137 Peking Rd. Persons residing in the Settlement North
of the Hongkew Creek register with the Jewish Gemeinde.

X. 21-3-1943
S.A.C.R.A. Notification No.3
Registration of Poles and Czechoslovaks. They have been
divided into 5 groups according to their names and have
to call at 137 Peking Rd, in order to obtain forms, in
alphabetical order on 5 successive days.

S.A.C.R.A. Notification No.4
Stateless refugees who have received forms from the
S.A.C.R.A. office or the Jewish Gemeinde are to return
the filled-in forms on 5 days, specified according to
the alphabetical order.
Persons who believe that they are entitled to exemption
with regard to para.3 of the official press communique
to the Proclamation of Febr.18th, are to send such
applications to the 137 Peking Rd Office not later than
March 31st,1943.

S.A.C.R.A. Notification No.5
Stateless refugees who have so far failed to register
with the S.A.C.R.A. , are to do so immediately. Those who
will not have registered by March 24th, although
affected by the Proclamation, will have to face consequences.

（签名：William）
D. S.

3月17日
S.A.C.R.A. 信息
所有受2月18日公告影响的无国籍难民，必须在 S.A.C.R.A. 提供的表格上进行登记。16岁及以下未成年人免予登记。
居住在虹口港以南公共租界、法租界及西区的人员，在北京路137号登记。居住在虹口港以北公共租界的人员，在犹太公会登记。

X. 1943年3月21日
S.A.C.R.A. 第3号通知
波兰人和捷克斯洛伐克人的登记。他们已按姓名分为5组，须在连续5天内按字母顺序前往北京路137号领取表格。

S.A.C.R.A. 第4号通知
已从 S.A.C.R.A. 办公室或犹太公会领取表格的无国籍难民，须按规定的5天期限（依字母顺序指定）交回填好的表格。
认为自己有权根据2月18日公告的官方新闻公报第3条获得豁免的人员，须在1943年3月31日之前将此类申请发送至北京路137号办公室。

S.A.C.R.A. 第5号通知
迄今尚未在 S.A.C.R.A. 登记的无国籍难民，须立即登记。那些虽受公告影响但在3月24日前仍未登记的人员，将面临后果。
